spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Predictive analysis isn't agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never give away your work.

domande.spiegazione: Agile estimating: projects are heavily people-based, so cost depends on the team (what you pay them and how many sprints). In predictive projects cost may come from materials, like steel and drywall on a building.

domande.domanda: A project manager oversees a large agile project to develop a new e-commerce platform. At the retrospective, the team notes that the product owner's expectations for the sprint deliverables were not fully met. What proactive measure should the project manager have taken?

opzioni.A: Hold a project kickoff workshop to ensure all team members are trained on the agile tools and techniques used.
opzioni.B: Establish a risk management framework that addresses potential misalignment between team outputs and stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Develop an integration plan to systematically align development work with ongoing marketing and sales strategy.
opzioni.D: Ensure the project vision and the objectives of each sprint were communicated to all team members.

domande.hint: Looking backwards: what should have been clear from the start?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. A kickoff happens once at the start; it doesn't cover each sprint.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It already happened: it isn't a risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The issue is the product owner's expectations, not marketing and sales.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The vision and sprint objectives should have been clearly communicated.

domande.spiegazione: Read carefully: the question looks backwards ('should have'). If the team wasn't sure what to deliver, that should have been clarified from the start: vision and objectives.

domande.domanda: A project manager is leading development of a new customer support software system. During a sprint, developers encounter ambiguity in a feature's acceptance criteria. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Request a meeting with the steering committee to discuss the feature.
opzioni.B: Initiate a discussion at the next team meeting to gather collective input.
opzioni.C: Refer the question to the technical architect for an expert interpretation.
opzioni.D: Collaborate with the product owner to resolve the ambiguity in the acceptance criteria.

domande.hint: Who defines the work and the acceptance criteria?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Acceptance criteria don't come from the steering committee.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The problem is between the team and the product owner, not within the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You need the product owner, not a technical architect.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The product owner defines the acceptance criteria.

domande.spiegazione: Agile principles: the product owner defines the work, what it should look like and how it should perform, so they create the acceptance criteria.

domande.domanda: During the execution phase of a development project, the team encounters a technical challenge that jeopardizes the scheduled delivery of key functionalities. The technical team has indicated a delay. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Schedule an emergency meeting with all stakeholders to brainstorm solutions.
opzioni.B: Initiate a quick training session for the technical team to enhance their problem-solving capabilities.
opzioni.C: Record the problem, its impact and urgency in the project issue log for structured tracking.
opzioni.D: Organize a team-building event to boost morale and encourage innovative thinking.

domande.hint: It's not a risk: it's already happening.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Careful with 'all': all stakeholders includes senior management and regulators. If anything, meet the technical team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The exam assumes the PM doesn't have the technical skills to train a technical team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. It's an issue: record it with its impact and urgency in the issue log.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Nothing says the team is demoralized: it doesn't answer the question.

domande.spiegazione: Easy if you notice it's an issue, not a risk: issues go in the issue log. Watch out for the word 'all' in any choice: it literally means everyone.

domande.domanda: During a pivotal project phase, it emerges that critical stakeholders did not attend the meeting focused on confirming the project's strategic alignment and expected business benefits, so their feedback was overlooked. This oversight has caused conflict in the decision-making process. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Initiate a discussion to directly address and understand their concerns.
opzioni.B: Distribute a detailed meeting summary and request written feedback from the absent stakeholders.
opzioni.C: Conduct a formal risk assessment to evaluate the impact of the missing stakeholder input.
opzioni.D: Develop a contingency plan to navigate potential project delays or changes.

domande.hint: Conflict: bring people together and get to the root cause.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Address the conflict directly and understand the root cause.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Sounds negative ('you weren't here, give me feedback').
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. They've already missed it: it's an issue, not a risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Nothing says there are delays.

domande.spiegazione: Whenever there's a conflict, bring people together, address it and solve it. Even the PMBOK Guide says to understand the problem before solving it: why did it happen, who started it, where did it come from?

domande.domanda: During a critical phase of the project, a pivotal team member tells the project manager they intend to resign and will soon submit their notice to their line manager. Their contribution is critical to meeting an upcoming deadline. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Have a senior team member hold a meeting to reassess task allocation and address any concerns.
opzioni.B: Update the project risk register to reflect the potential impact on the project timeline.
opzioni.C: Brief the stakeholders on the situation to set realistic expectations about potential delays.
opzioni.D: Proactively collaborate with other team members to formulate a transition plan and mitigate project disruption.

domande.hint: Be proactive and work with the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never give away your work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not bad, but it only looks at the timeline (it can also affect scope) and you'd assess it alone.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. How do you know there will be a delay? Maybe the team can handle the work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Work with the team on a transition plan to mitigate disruption.

domande.spiegazione: Someone is leaving at a critical time: meet with the team, be proactive and plan the transition together. B and C assume a delay before you've worked with the team.

domande.domanda: In a software development project, as the team moves into development, they decide to use time tracking to estimate effort, with one hour of effort equal to one point. Some tasks are estimated at 5 points, while others go up to 200 points. To improve estimate accuracy and scheduling, what should the project manager encourage the team to do?

opzioni.A: Recommend dividing tasks into subtasks to improve manageability and estimation accuracy.
opzioni.B: Have the team use a new estimating technique that better reflects complexity.
opzioni.C: Encourage the adoption of a fixed-point system for all tasks.
opzioni.D: Have the team recalibrate the point system to better differentiate simple and complex tasks.

domande.hint: Recommend, don't impose; accurate estimates need small chunks.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Recommending decomposition (used in both agile and traditional) improves accuracy.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You're telling the team what to do.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. A fixed point for all tasks makes no sense, and watch the word 'all'.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You're telling the team what to do.

domande.spiegazione: Use the mindset: recommend rather than tell the team what to do. To estimate accurately, work has to be broken into smaller chunks: decomposition.

domande.domanda: A tech startup is gearing up to launch a groundbreaking app by the upcoming summer. During initial planning, it encounters uncertainty in the project specifications: it isn't sure how stakeholders will use the product. What should the project manager do to keep the project on track?

opzioni.A: Incorporate insights from technology consultants.
opzioni.B: Establish a comprehensive risk management framework to anticipate and mitigate potential delays.
opzioni.C: Assess the team and propose a minimum viable product (MVP).
opzioni.D: Organize workshops with the project team to solidify the project's technical requirements.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Uncertainty is resolved by customers, not consultants.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Good, but it only talks about delays: here the issue is scope, not schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. An MVP gives customers usable features and their feedback says what to change or update.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The team can't solidify requirements without the customer's input.

domande.spiegazione: An MVP isn't the full product but has a set of usable features: customers use it and tell you whether you're on the right track. It's one of the best ways to address uncertainty on a project.

domande.domanda: During a large-scale event planning project, the project manager notices a growing list of logistical challenges reported by team members. Although acknowledged in team meetings, few have been effectively resolved, creating potential risks to the event's success. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Schedule additional planning sessions focused specifically on logistical challenges.
opzioni.B: Assign a dedicated team to focus solely on identifying and resolving logistical issues.
opzioni.C: Prioritize the logistical challenges based on their potential impact on the event.
opzioni.D: Increase the frequency of team meetings to ensure more regular updates on challenges.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The problem isn't planning: additional planning sessions don't help.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never give away your work: work with the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. With potential risks, prioritize them by their impact on the event.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. More meetings don't solve the challenges.

domande.spiegazione: When there are risks, they must be prioritized by impact. Ideally you'd do it with the team, but C is the best of these four.

domande.domanda: During the execution phase of an urban development project, the project manager uses email updates to keep all stakeholders informed. Feedback shows some stakeholders find the information too technical and others too general. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Initiate one-on-one briefings for stakeholders needing detailed explanations.
opzioni.B: Organize a workshop to keep them informed.
opzioni.C: Evaluate the specific needs of the stakeholders.
opzioni.D: Launch a project blog providing updates at varying levels of detail.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. With many stakeholders on an urban project, it would take forever.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Some may want a workshop, others may not.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Understand each stakeholder's needs and tailor the communication.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Good, but after evaluating their needs (C, then maybe D).

domande.spiegazione: Communication is tailored to each stakeholder: before sending anything, understand what they need.

domande.domanda: During the deployment phase of a new telecommunications network, the project encounters significant delays. What should the project manager do to identify and mitigate these delays?

opzioni.A: Increase the frequency of project status meetings to enhance communication.
opzioni.B: Reallocate resources to the most delayed aspects of the project.
opzioni.C: Adjust the timeline to accommodate the unexpected delays.
opzioni.D: Facilitate a collaborative session with the team to pinpoint and tackle the delays.

domande.hint: Problem on the project: ask the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. More status meetings without working with the team don't solve it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never reallocate resources without the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You can't adjust timelines as needed: on a traditional project you need a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Work with the team to find the causes and solve them.

domande.spiegazione: Easy if you've followed along: whenever there's a problem on the project, ask the team to help you solve it.

domande.domanda: A key stakeholder asks the project manager to deliver a critical infrastructure component two weeks ahead of schedule. After assessing the situation, the project manager determines that accelerating the schedule is possible by overlapping certain processes. What is the most effective course of action?

opzioni.A: Re-evaluate the project scope to identify non-essential elements that can be postponed.
opzioni.B: Adjust the timeline by resequencing work to allow parallel activities.
opzioni.C: Increase the budget to allow for overtime and additional resources.
opzioni.D: Use advanced technology to automate certain construction processes.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Postponing parts of the scope requires a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Fast tracking: you can rearrange activities without a change request as long as the end date doesn't change (if it gets shorter, fine).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. That's crashing: it increases cost and requires a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Goes beyond the scope of the question.

domande.spiegazione: Tricky: overlapping activities is fast tracking, not crashing. Fast tracking reduces time and increases risk, but generally not cost.

domande.domanda: At the start of a software development project, the project manager is tasked with devising a strategy to assess each developer's contribution. The assessments will be compiled and presented to organizational leadership at the project's conclusion. What should the project manager's next step be?

opzioni.A: Arrange regular one-on-one meetings with each developer to discuss and document their progress.
opzioni.B: Develop clear, quantifiable criteria for evaluating developer performance and communicate them to the team.
opzioni.C: Use software development metrics such as lines of code to directly measure developer productivity.
opzioni.D: Conduct anonymous surveys among team members to gather insights on individual contributions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Comes after defining the criteria (B, then A).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Define measurable criteria and make sure everyone knows them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Lines of code don't measure quality or contribution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Anonymous surveys are neither transparent nor objective.

domande.spiegazione: More of an ethics question: be fair and upfront, let people know what's being assessed. Measurable criteria, communicated to everyone.

domande.domanda: At the start of a new environmental conservation project, a key stakeholder expresses concern about the project's approach, fearing it won't meet the intended environmental goals and will exceed the initial forecast. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Organize a meeting with the stakeholder to understand the concerns and identify potential improvements.
opzioni.B: Launch a pilot phase to demonstrate the project's effectiveness and adjust based on early results.
opzioni.C: Enhance communication with the stakeholder through regular updates and closer involvement in project planning.
opzioni.D: Outline the long-term benefits and sustainability impacts of the project, emphasizing its alignment with broader environmental objectives.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Meet the stakeholder, understand the concern and assess the situation.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. An action taken before understanding the concern.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. An action taken before understanding the concern.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Pushes the project's view without understanding the concern.

domande.spiegazione: Whenever a stakeholder has a concern and the question says 'first', don't act against it: meet the stakeholder, see what's going on and assess the situation.

domande.domanda: While implementing a new healthcare IT system, the project manager faces a challenge: the initial phase, upgrading the existing hardware, is behind schedule, affecting the subsequent software implementation phase because the technical teams are shared. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Negotiate with other project managers for temporary resource sharing to expedite the hardware upgrade.
opzioni.B: Initiate an assessment of the delay's impact on the overall project timeline.
opzioni.C: Implement a reward system for the technical team to incentivize faster completion.
opzioni.D: Engage a consultant to provide expert advice on streamlining the hardware upgrade.

domande.hint: Be careful with actions: assess first.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. An action taken before understanding the impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Understand how it really affects the project before acting.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. An action taken before understanding the impact.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. An action taken before understanding the impact.

domande.spiegazione: Before negotiating resources, rewarding or hiring a consultant, understand exactly how the delay affects the project (time and budget). Assess before taking action.

domande.domanda: At the midpoint of a renewable energy project, the project manager faces a conflict between the design team and the environmental consultants over the proposed turbine placement. The design team believes it will optimize energy production, while the consultants warn it could cause significant ecological disruption. What should the project manager do to resolve the conflict?

opzioni.A: Proceed with the design team's recommendation to maximize energy output.
opzioni.B: Organize a collaborative session to discuss the impacts and find a compromise.
opzioni.C: Commission an independent review of the turbine placement.
opzioni.D: Postpone the decision on turbine placement until further data is available.

domande.hint: Conflict between two parties: don't take sides.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Choosing a side is forcing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Bring them together to find a solution: compromise isn't ideal, but they're involved.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You'd decide without involving them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Postponing is kicking the can down the road.

domande.spiegazione: With a conflict between people, help them resolve it: don't take sides (forcing). Compromise isn't the best technique, but you don't want to decide without them.

domande.domanda: After a new project has started execution, an executive suggests adding a new add-on to provide more functionality to the product. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Update the product immediately to include the suggested add-on without formal approval.
opzioni.B: Note the suggestion for inclusion in a separate risk assessment document.
opzioni.C: Integrate the executive's feedback into an appendix of the current report.
opzioni.D: Encourage the executive to formalize the suggestion through the change request process.

domande.hint: Traditional project: a scope change goes through change control.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never include a scope change without formal approval: approving isn't your job.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Puts it in a document without dealing with the add-on itself.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Puts it in a report without dealing with the add-on itself.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The add-on is a scope change: it goes through change control.

domande.spiegazione: The best assumption is a traditional project. An add-on is a scope change and must go through change control: your job is to manage the team building the deliverable, not to approve or reject changes.

domande.domanda: At the start of an urban regeneration project, the project manager observes that although team morale is high, meetings often drift into unrelated conversations, causing them to overrun and decisions to be postponed. What is the most effective initial action?

opzioni.A: Schedule shorter meetings to encourage more focused discussion.
opzioni.B: Designate a timekeeper to ensure meetings adhere to scheduled times.
opzioni.C: Emphasize the meeting objectives and agenda at the beginning of each session.
opzioni.D: Introduce a digital platform for team members to share non-project discussions.

domande.hint: 'Initial action': the simplest, least drastic one.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Drastic: it literally cuts the meetings down.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Possibly later, if C doesn't work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Simplest first step: remind everyone what needs to be done in the meeting.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Drastic: a whole new piece of software.

domande.spiegazione: The keyword is 'initial': the first thing you try should never be the hardest. Solve problems the easiest way possible ('folks, we need to stay on topic'); if that fails, move on to B, A or D.

domande.domanda: A project manager notes that one key technical analyst, although exceptionally knowledgeable, rarely contributes to group discussions despite engaging actively in private conversations. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Schedule a dedicated session where only the technical analyst presents their findings to the team.
opzioni.B: Actively solicit the analyst's input during meetings, emphasizing the importance of their expertise to the project's success.
opzioni.C: Create an anonymous feedback mechanism where the analyst can submit insights without speaking up in meetings.
opzioni.D: Wait for the analyst to naturally become more comfortable and contribute at their own pace.

domande.hint: The goal: get the analyst contributing in group discussions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Same scenario (speaking in front of the team), but without you there.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Engage them directly in meetings, valuing their expertise.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. If only the analyst uses it, it isn't really anonymous.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Doing nothing: you might wait forever.

domande.spiegazione: Tough: address what the question asks, getting the analyst to contribute in the group. People talk to them privately, but nobody engages them in meetings: you do it. Between A and B, in A they'd be speaking in front of people anyway, just without you.

domande.domanda: Just before the final review of a new software product, the quality assurance team tells the project manager that several key features don't meet the specifications agreed with the client. Correcting them will delay delivery by several weeks. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Prioritize work to meet the agreed specifications, accepting that the timeline may need to be extended.
opzioni.B: Suggest a partial delivery to the client with non-compliant features updated in a future release.
opzioni.C: Propose a compromise on the specifications to the client, reducing the scope to match the current state.
opzioni.D: Consult the development team to find a faster solution that reduces the delay while meeting the specifications.

domande.hint: 'Next': who do you go to first?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Accepts the delay without first looking for alternatives with the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Delivers non-compliant features.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Reduces scope without first exploring solutions with the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Ask the team whether it can be done faster while meeting the specifications.

domande.spiegazione: Careful with 'next'. Even if QA tells you, go to the development team and ask whether there's a way to reduce the delay.

domande.domanda: ⚠️ During a critical phase of an agile development project, a specialist responsible for designing a key component unexpectedly has to take extensive medical leave. Their tasks are now at risk of delay because they were the only person with the necessary expertise. What proactive measure could the project manager have taken to mitigate this risk? — ⚠️ Note: options/text partly reconstructed from the transcript; answer letter inferred from the commentary.

opzioni.A: Build a cross-functional team.
opzioni.B: Distribute the specialist's tasks among several members from the project's onset.
opzioni.C: Establish a comprehensive documentation practice for all project tasks.
opzioni.D: Allocate additional funds to hire temporary specialists if needed.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. A cross-functional team of generalizing specialists can help each other and reduces bottlenecks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. How could you have predicted it? You'd have to do it for everyone, not just this person.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Good, but the task is specialist work: only that person could do it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Throwaway: unless you'd predicted it in the risk assessment.

domande.spiegazione: 'Proactive' is the keyword: what could you have done to prevent or soften the blow? In agile you build a cross-functional team of generalizing specialists so everyone can help, reducing bottlenecks.
domande.nota: Options reconstructed from the transcript (letter order partly inferred).
domande.motivo_incertezza: options/text partly reconstructed from the transcript; answer letter inferred from the commentary

domande.domanda: In the planning phase of a large software implementation, the project manager decides to perform an extensive analysis of risks to the timeline and budget. The goal is to understand the likelihood of completing the project within the defined parameters and to identify which variables most affect the outcome, using many different perspectives. Which technique should the project manager apply?

opzioni.A: Develop a risk breakdown structure.
opzioni.B: Conduct a sensitivity analysis.
opzioni.C: Use a cause-and-effect diagram.
opzioni.D: Run a Monte Carlo simulation.

domande.hint: Many scenarios and perspectives: likelihood of completion.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Categorizes risks, but doesn't calculate likelihood.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Shows the impact of individual variables, not the probability of completion across many scenarios.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Shows the causes of a problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Monte Carlo simulates many scenarios and gives the probability of completion.

domande.spiegazione: A knowledge question written in a difficult way. Monte Carlo looks at many different scenarios and outcomes (e.g. a category 4 or 5 hurricane, a blizzard) and how each would affect the project.

domande.domanda: On a project to develop a new CRM system, the project manager learns at a stakeholder meeting that upcoming regulatory changes will affect data handling within the system. The changes will be enforced shortly after the project's planned completion date. What is the most appropriate action to keep the project compliant with the new regulations?

opzioni.A: Add the regulations to the project's risk log for future analysis.
opzioni.B: Plan to address the regulations in the next CRM system development.
opzioni.C: Integrate discussion of the regulatory changes into the project phases.
opzioni.D: Request detailed information and make the changes at the next product update meeting.

domande.hint: 'Will affect': it's not a risk, it's certain.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. It's not a risk: it will happen (risks have a probability).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You can't wait for the next system.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. You have to deal with it now, within the project phases.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You can't wait: if you release without it, you'll have to redo it.

domande.spiegazione: Tricky. It isn't a risk, because it 'will' affect the system: it's certain. You have to deal with it now, otherwise you'll release something that has to be redone.

domande.domanda: During a mobile app development project, the project manager faces significant uncertainty about user preferences and the effectiveness of the proposed features. Initial user feedback has been inconclusive, raising questions about the project's direction. What is the best course of action to ensure the project aligns with user expectations?

opzioni.A: Finish developing the application, then correct all features not aligned with user expectations.
opzioni.B: Proceed with creating a minimum viable product (MVP).
opzioni.C: Pause development until a comprehensive market analysis provides clear guidance on user preferences.
opzioni.D: Instruct the development team to incorporate the most popular features to ensure relevance.

domande.hint: Uncertainty about user preferences: get usable feedback quickly.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Building everything and correcting later is wasteful.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. An MVP gives users something usable and returns concrete feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Don't stop the project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You don't know which features are popular: that's exactly the uncertainty.

domande.spiegazione: An MVP is something minimal but usable that you release to get feedback: it doesn't need every feature. A popular exam topic.

domande.domanda: Anticipating new environmental regulations, a manufacturing project involving two distinct operational teams, one using traditional methods and the other green technology, must evaluate the regulations' impact on combined operations. What is the most effective action to ensure compliance and seamless integration?

opzioni.A: Organize a collaborative workshop with representatives from both teams to discuss compliance strategies.
opzioni.B: Conduct separate workshops for each team to focus on adapting their specific operations.
opzioni.C: Hold individual strategy sessions with each team, followed by a joint session.
opzioni.D: Assemble a panel of regulatory experts to provide guidance and recommendations to both teams.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Bring the two teams together to work on a shared strategy.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Each team on its own: no integration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Starts separate: the joint work comes too late.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Brings outsiders in instead of making the teams collaborate.

domande.spiegazione: The PM is a facilitator who drives collaboration: always bring people together and let them work together, especially on something like a regulation that affects combined operations.

domande.domanda: The goal on a project is to foster a culture of cooperation that drives the team to exceptional performance. Following a recommendation from the company's founder, the project manager decides to adopt a servant leadership approach. What should the project manager do to effectively embody servant leadership?

opzioni.A: Implement a competitive reward system to incentivize individual excellence.
opzioni.B: Direct the team to refine its strategies continuously until it devises an unbeatable plan.
opzioni.C: Evaluate the project scope meticulously and set clear, prioritized goals to encourage team alignment and focus.
opzioni.D: Establish clear project goals and nurture a supportive environment that enables team members to contribute to their fullest potential.

domande.hint: Which of the good answers is servant leadership?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Throwaway: a servant leader supports the team rather than making members compete.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Directing the team isn't servant leadership.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Good, but setting priorities for the team isn't servant leadership.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. A supportive environment that lets everyone give their best is servant leadership.

domande.spiegazione: Three answers are technically good: which one is servant leadership? Supporting the team and helping it reach its full potential.

domande.domanda: During a critical phase of a remotely operated environmental research project, key departures require the swift integration of new members unfamiliar with the project's specific challenges and objectives. Extensive documentation exists, but the project's complexity might hinder the rapid understanding needed. What proactive measure should the project manager implement to ensure new members integrate effectively?

opzioni.A: Arrange for the new member to shadow an experienced team member for hands-on learning.
opzioni.B: Encourage the new member to study the documentation, followed by a session to discuss their role.
opzioni.C: Schedule a series of training webinars on the project's methodology and technologies.
opzioni.D: Facilitate a workshop with the team focusing on the project's complexities, with all current and new members attending.

domande.hint: Which option brings the team together?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Like saying 'go follow that guy': giving the work away.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Decent, but the person studies alone.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Could take time, and in a webinar the person might not participate.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Brings the whole team together with the new members: servant leadership.

domande.spiegazione: Lots of big words: first ask what they want. Someone new lacks familiarity with the project: what proactive measure brings the team together so the new person isn't on their own?

domande.domanda: In a routine progress check, an agile project manager notices that a lead analyst habitually passes off less complex analysis work to newer team members, saying it lets them concentrate on the more intricate aspects of the project. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Develop a rotational task assignment system to ensure all members gain experience across a range of tasks.
opzioni.B: Directly assign tasks based on complexity to ensure each member works within their capability.
opzioni.C: Establish a mentorship program where senior members guide junior members through complex tasks.
opzioni.D: Discuss at the next team meeting to evaluate the effectiveness of the current delegation method.

domande.hint: The team found a way of working: is it effective?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Puts you in charge and shuts the team off.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Direct assignment: you decide for the team.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Still telling them what to do.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Evaluate with the team whether the current method works.

domande.spiegazione: Tough, though it seems easy. The team came up with a way of working it thinks is effective: don't stop it, evaluate it with them. PMs aren't 'the smart ones' who code or build: we're facilitators and collaborators.

domande.domanda: As a critical update to an e-commerce platform nears completion, stakeholders make a last-minute request for additional features that would significantly improve customer experience but require extensive extra work, potentially affecting the launch timeline. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Expedite the process by incorporating the new features into the plan.
opzioni.B: Calculate the additional cost and request an immediate budget increase.
opzioni.C: Reject the request outright to maintain focus.
opzioni.D: Discuss implementing the requested features with the development team and present feasible solutions to the stakeholders.

domande.hint: Never reject: analyze with the team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never incorporate without analysis.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Analyzes, but alone, and asks for money straight away.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Never reject: negative answers aren't the answer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Analyze with the team, then present options to stakeholders.

domande.spiegazione: Never pick an option that rejects, fires, says no or stops something: it's negative. B is good because it analyzes, but D is better because it involves the team.

domande.domanda: During the development phase of an international public health project, the project manager faces skepticism from government partners about the project's achievements due to limited visibility into progress. What should the project manager do to address this?

opzioni.A: Start a monthly newsletter focusing on project milestones and challenges.
opzioni.B: Arrange a series of workshops with project beneficiaries to showcase the project's impact directly.
opzioni.C: Organize a virtual meeting with government partners to ask how they would like project updates and to answer any questions.
opzioni.D: Compile an extensive report on project outcomes and planned activities, distributed quarterly.

domande.hint: Should you decide how they get updates, or ask them?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You're deciding what's best for them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. You're deciding what's best for them.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Ask them how they'd like to receive updates on progress.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You're deciding what's best for them.

domande.spiegazione: Easy if you read carefully: the skepticism comes from limited visibility. Don't decide how to show progress: ask them first.

domande.domanda: During implementation of an innovative mobile banking app, a significant regulatory update requires adjustments to several key features. The agile project manager meets with the responsible regulatory compliance officer, who is new to the project, to discuss the required changes. What should the project manager do to ensure the updates are efficiently integrated into the scope?

opzioni.A: Ask the compliance officer to formalize the regulatory updates in writing and submit them to the change control board for approval.
opzioni.B: Encourage the compliance officer to detail the regulatory changes for inclusion in the product backlog.
opzioni.C: Instruct the compliance officer to communicate the changes to the development team at the next daily scrum.
opzioni.D: Ask the compliance officer to assess the project plan and suggest modifications to accommodate the new regulations.

domande.hint: Agile: scope changes go into the product backlog.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The CCB is for traditional projects, not agile.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Agile scope changes go into the product backlog, managed by the product owner.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The daily scrum isn't the place to introduce scope changes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. There isn't really a project plan to modify in agile.

domande.spiegazione: Keep in mind it's agile: scope is managed very differently from traditional projects. Required changes go into the product backlog.

domande.domanda: The project manager notices that the integration process is more cumbersome than anticipated, significantly slowing progress. This is mainly due to a newly implemented IT protocol designed to improve security. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Introduce additional training sessions for the team on the new IT protocol.
opzioni.B: Require the team to double their efforts to meet the deadline despite the protocol.
opzioni.C: Organize a workshop to identify workarounds to the IT protocol that don't compromise security.
opzioni.D: Initiate discussions with IT leadership and the team to understand the protocol's implementation and how best to facilitate the project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You don't know yet whether training is the problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Negative: overworking people (16 hours a day?).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Maybe later, after D.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Talk to IT and the team to see whether the protocol can be implemented better or IT can accommodate the project.

domande.spiegazione: Never pick negative options like overworking people. Follow the mindset: be collaborative, meet everyone and understand before acting (D first, then maybe C).

domande.domanda: ⚠️ As the project manager of an app development project, a stakeholder asks you to add a feature that mirrors the functionality of something developed in a previous sprint. The stakeholder wants a quick estimate of how this addition might affect schedule and cost. What should you do to provide it accurately? — ⚠️ Note: debatable: the instructor sees more than one valid answer.

opzioni.A: Calculate the new feature's impact by comparing it to the total budget, adjusted for the proportion of work already completed.
opzioni.B: Meet with the product owner to help with the estimate.
opzioni.C: Review the user stories and velocity metrics from the previous sprint for the similar feature to estimate the effort for the new addition.
opzioni.D: Initiate a detailed risk analysis of incorporating the new feature, focusing on potential schedule and budget overruns.

domande.hint: None is perfect: choose the best of the four.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Neither quick nor accurate.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The product owner doesn't estimate: you and the team do.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Use the velocity and actual data on similar work: quick and grounded.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A risk analysis takes too long.

domande.spiegazione: All four are basically wrong: the best answer would be 'ask the team'. Since that isn't a choice, pick the best of the four: estimates come from velocity and the stories of similar work.
domande.nota: The instructor: none is perfect (best would be to ask the team), C is the best of the four.
domande.motivo_incertezza: debatable: the instructor sees more than one valid answer

domande.domanda: During a complex software development project, the project manager notices significant variances between the planned and the actual performance metrics. Key deliverables are at risk of being delayed because of these discrepancies. What should the project manager do first to ensure the project objectives are met?

opzioni.A: Adjust the timeline and communicate the changes to all stakeholders.
opzioni.B: Conduct a detailed analysis of the performance data to identify the root causes.
opzioni.C: Request additional resources to accelerate the project work and meet the schedule targets.
opzioni.D: Reassess the project's risk management strategies to better align them with the current challenges.

domande.hint: There is a problem and the question says 'first': assess, review, evaluate, analyze before acting.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Changing the schedule without understanding what is causing the variance is an action taken before knowing the problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Analyzing the actual performance data finds the root cause of the variance; only then can you choose the right action.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Asking for more resources before knowing what the problem is may not solve anything.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The variances have already happened, so this is not a risk, and the risk management strategy is about how risk is managed, not the specific responses.

domande.spiegazione: When there is a problem on a project, don't take actions first: assess, review, evaluate and analyze. A detailed analysis of the performance data comes before changing the schedule or asking for resources.

domande.domanda: ⚠️ On a large infrastructure project, the project manager faces sudden regulatory changes that could potentially impact the scope and the cost. The project is currently on track, but the changes might require adjustments to project execution. What should the project manager do first? — ⚠️ Note: options/text partly reconstructed from the transcript.

opzioni.A: Update the budget and the timeline based on a preliminary assessment of the changes.
opzioni.B: Initiate a stakeholder meeting to discuss the impacts and the needed adjustments.
opzioni.C: Conduct a comprehensive review of the regulatory changes to assess their impact on the project.
opzioni.D: Implement the regulatory changes in the project immediately.

domande.hint: 'Could potentially' and 'first': the change may or may not affect the project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. You should never update the project based only on a preliminary assessment: get a proper assessment first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Before meeting with the stakeholders you need to analyze the regulation yourself, so you know what to discuss.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Analyze how the change affects the project: how much it adds or removes from scope and budget and, as a consequence, the schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never implement a change before analyzing it: this was the throwaway answer.

domande.spiegazione: When a question asks what to do first, the answer is rarely to fix the problem or implement what is asked: it is to analyze it. Review the regulatory change and its impact on scope, budget and schedule before updating plans or meeting stakeholders.
domande.nota: Option text reconstructed from the transcript (the instructor reads options C and D quickly).
domande.motivo_incertezza: options/text partly reconstructed from the transcript

domande.domanda: ⚠️ A project manager is overseeing the construction of a new office building. The project is running over budget because of the high cost of materials. The project team suggests several options to cut costs, including using fewer materials that may slightly reduce durability, simplifying the building design, or eliminating some non-essential features. Which approach should the project manager use to address the cost while ensuring the building meets its intended purpose? — ⚠️ Note: answer letter inferred from the commentary.

opzioni.A: Value engineering.
opzioni.B: Critical path method.
opzioni.C: Earned value analysis.
opzioni.D: Monte Carlo simulation.

domande.hint: Definition question: deliver what the customer wants at the lowest cost.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Value engineering is about delivering what the customer wants (the same functions) in the cheapest or most cost-effective way, which is exactly what the scenario describes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The critical path method builds the schedule and identifies the critical path; it doesn't address cost.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Earned value is the set of formulas used to track the budget and see how far you are on or off it; it measures cost, it doesn't reduce it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Monte Carlo runs hundreds or thousands of simulations to estimate budget, schedule or risks; it doesn't find cheaper ways to deliver.

domande.spiegazione: Value engineering: if you're told to buy a specific car (the scope is known), your goal is to get it as cheaply as possible. Same scope and functions, lowest cost.
domande.nota: Option order reconstructed: the instructor reads the options inconsistently and then says 'A is the best answer'.
domande.motivo_incertezza: answer letter inferred from the commentary

domande.domanda: ⚠️ During a project charter review session, a dispute arises between the sponsor and the product owner, witnessed by the team and other stakeholders. What should the project manager do to manage the conflict and continue the project? — ⚠️ Note: answer letter inferred from the commentary.

opzioni.A: Propose a follow-up session after the meeting to address the unresolved issues.
opzioni.B: Facilitate the meeting actively, using conflict resolution strategies to manage the dispute and maintain team cohesion.
opzioni.C: Adjourn the meeting immediately and suggest a cooling-off period.
opzioni.D: Arrange a separate conflict resolution session with a neutral facilitator to assist the parties.

domande.hint: The exam wants a direct, confronting approach.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Postponing to a follow-up session doesn't deal with the conflict when it happens.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Take an active, confronting approach: facilitate the meeting and manage the dispute right away. Managed conflict is good.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Adjourning the meeting is withdrawing from the conflict.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A separate session with an outside facilitator postpones the problem and gives it away.

domande.spiegazione: Conflict happens in every meeting; it's how humans work. Conflict is not bad: managed conflict is good. Unmanaged conflict can escalate, so take an active approach and resolve it immediately.
domande.nota: The instructor says 'D' but describes option B and concludes 'B best answer'.
domande.motivo_incertezza: answer letter inferred from the commentary

domande.domanda: A project manager is tasked with organizing the risks for a new infrastructure project. To ensure comprehensive risk management, the project manager decides to use a risk breakdown structure (RBS). However, the team is concerned that the RBS may become overly complex and difficult to manage. What should the project manager do to create an effective and manageable RBS?

opzioni.A: Develop a simple categorization scheme that only includes high-priority risks.
opzioni.B: Use an existing RBS from a similar project and adapt it to the current project's needs.
opzioni.C: Create a detailed RBS with multiple subcategories to capture all potential risks.
opzioni.D: Involve key stakeholders in the development of the RBS to ensure it is comprehensive and manageable.

domande.hint: What does an RBS contain, and who helps you build it well?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The RBS doesn't contain risks (those are in the risk register): it categorizes them, and it isn't limited to high-priority risks.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. A good idea, but every project is unique: it's better to get people involved.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It could work, but it risks the very complexity the team fears; involving people is better.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The more key stakeholders (team members, subject matter experts) are involved, the better the RBS will be and the more likely the project succeeds.

domande.spiegazione: The RBS categorizes risks; the categories are then used in the risk register. The more people involved in identifying and structuring risks, the more likely you are to succeed.

domande.domanda: On a construction project, the project manager decides to apply value engineering to enhance the project's value. The goal is to improve the ratio of function to cost by analyzing and proposing cost-effective solutions. What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Have the team conduct a brainstorming session to remove functions to reduce cost.
opzioni.B: Focus solely on reducing cost, even if it means compromising functionality.
opzioni.C: Engage with stakeholders to understand the critical functions.
opzioni.D: Implement all proposed changes immediately to maximize cost savings.

domande.hint: Value engineering keeps the functions the same and makes them cheaper.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Value engineering never removes functions just to reduce cost: it keeps the functions the same.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never compromise on functionality.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Before optimizing or finding cheaper alternatives, understand which functions are critical to the stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You don't implement all changes at once; that probably won't maximize function.

domande.spiegazione: It mentions value engineering but it's a mindset question about 'first'. Value engineering delivers the same functions more cost-effectively, so first understand the critical functions, then look for cheaper alternatives that deliver them.

domande.domanda: A project manager is conducting a value engineering workshop to identify ways to improve a project's value. During the session, a team member suggests replacing a component with a cheaper alternative that slightly reduces performance but saves a significant amount of money. What should the project manager do to determine whether the solution aligns with value engineering?

opzioni.A: Approve the change, since it reduces the overall project cost.
opzioni.B: Reject the change, since it reduces performance.
opzioni.C: Evaluate whether the reduction in performance impacts the project's functionality.
opzioni.D: Implement the change if it doesn't require additional stakeholder approval.

domande.hint: Someone proposes a change: what does a PM always do first?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never approve a change without evaluating it first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Never reject a change without evaluating it first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Evaluate the change: if functionality isn't affected, it fits value engineering.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never implement a change without evaluating it first.

domande.spiegazione: Use the mindset: when somebody asks for a change, evaluate it. Never approve, reject or implement a change without evaluating it; that's part of being a project manager.

domande.domanda: A project manager is working on a large infrastructure project that is facing schedule delays. The project manager wants to use an advanced forecasting technique to predict the future status and progress of the project. The team has been using earned value management (EVM) to track progress. What should the project manager do to forecast the project completion date accurately?

opzioni.A: Apply the schedule performance index (SPI) to the remaining work and calculate an estimate at completion (EAC).
opzioni.B: Conduct a Monte Carlo simulation to account for potential variations in the schedule.
opzioni.C: Use the critical path method (CPM) to re-evaluate the timeline.
opzioni.D: Implement rolling wave planning to adjust future work plans.

domande.hint: They already use EVM: which EVM tool forecasts?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. EVM includes the SPI; used with the EAC, it forecasts the schedule from current performance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Monte Carlo runs multiple simulations of what can affect the schedule; it helps build a schedule more than predict it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. CPM helps develop the schedule, not predict it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Rolling wave is planning to replan; it's a planning technique, not EVM forecasting during execution.

domande.spiegazione: A definition question: if you know earned value management, you know the SPI (schedule performance index) can be used with the EAC to forecast completion.

domande.domanda: A software development project is midway through its timeline, and the project manager notices that actual progress is lagging behind the planned schedule. The sponsor is concerned about meeting the upcoming milestone. Which technique should the project manager use to address the sponsor's concern and predict the project completion date?

opzioni.A: Create a trend analysis using historical performance data.
opzioni.B: Apply earned value management (EVM) to calculate the schedule variance and forecast completion.
opzioni.C: Use three-point estimating to forecast future tasks.
opzioni.D: Perform a resource leveling analysis to optimize resource allocation.

domande.hint: Predict completion from what is happening now.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Useful, but based only on history: EVM is more accurate because it uses what's happening now.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. EVM, and the EAC in particular, can predict both budget and schedule from current performance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Three-point estimating gives the duration of an activity; it doesn't predict completion.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Resource leveling ensures no one is over-allocated or working overtime; it doesn't predict anything.

domande.spiegazione: Definition question, similar to the previous one: the estimate at completion (EAC) predicts budget and schedule, and EVM is more accurate than historical trends because it is based on current performance.

domande.domanda: A construction project has experienced significant delays because of many unforeseen weather conditions, raising concerns about meeting the final deadline. The project manager needs to predict the potential impact on the project completion date and communicate it. Which approach should the project manager take?

opzioni.A: Update the Gantt chart with the new weather delay information and manually adjust the timeline.
opzioni.B: Use a Monte Carlo simulation to predict the probability of various completion dates.
opzioni.C: Apply critical path analysis to identify which activities can be fast-tracked.
opzioni.D: Perform a cost-benefit analysis to decide whether to hire additional resources to mitigate the delays.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. A Gantt chart is used to show the schedule; it doesn't predict the outcome of many scenarios.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Monte Carlo goes through many different simulations ('scenarios') and gives the probability of each completion date.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. CPM builds the schedule; it doesn't predict results across multiple scenarios.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not yet: first understand how the weather affects the project, then decide whether more resources are needed.

domande.spiegazione: When something goes through many different simulations or scenarios, that's the definition of Monte Carlo.

domande.domanda: A project manager is preparing for a quality audit of a new software development project. The audit team needs to ensure the project's quality management system aligns with the organization's standards and to identify areas for improvement. What is the most effective course of action for the project manager to take after the quality audit?

opzioni.A: Provide the team with all project documents and ask them to review them.
opzioni.B: Prepare the team to answer any questions from the auditors.
opzioni.C: Collaborate with the team to understand the findings and develop corrective actions.
opzioni.D: Focus on presenting the project's successes to highlight the team's performance.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Providing the documents is something you do during the audit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Preparing the team to answer questions is done before the audit.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. After the audit you work with the team on the findings and develop corrective actions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Presenting successes is something done after the project, not part of the audit.

domande.spiegazione: Read carefully: the question asks what happens after the audit. Before: prepare the team; during: provide documents; after: understand the findings and develop corrective actions with the team.

domande.domanda: During the execution phase of a manufacturing project, an internal audit team reveals several non-conformances in the production process and identifies them as potential risks to the project's success. What should the project manager do about these non-conformances?

opzioni.A: Immediately halt the production process until all non-conformances are resolved.
opzioni.B: Develop and implement corrective actions to address the non-conformances identified by the audit team.
opzioni.C: Dismiss the non-conformances as minor issues and continue.
opzioni.D: Inform the sponsor about the non-conformances and request additional resources.

domande.hint: It doesn't ask what to do first: it asks how to fix the problem.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never halt a project like this: only stop for safety (someone might be injured) or legal reasons.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Fix the problem: develop and implement corrective actions for the non-conformances.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Never dismiss, never ignore anyone, never kick the can down the road or do nothing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Never go to the sponsor for help: they hired you to solve the problem.

domande.spiegazione: Notice the question doesn't say 'first' or 'next': it literally asks how you will fix this. So the answer is a concrete fix: corrective actions.

domande.domanda: ⚠️ In the middle of a large infrastructure project, the project manager receives a report from an external quality auditor highlighting several significant non-conformances. If not addressed, these issues could impact the timeline and the budget. What should the project manager do to address the non-conformances effectively? — ⚠️ Note: debatable: the instructor sees more than one valid answer.

opzioni.A: Continue with the current plan and monitor the non-conformances, escalating if needed.
opzioni.B: Request the sponsor to review the auditor's report.
opzioni.C: Adjust the project scope to account for the identified non-conformances.
opzioni.D: Integrate the corrective actions recommended in the audit report into the project plan.

domande.hint: None is perfect: choose the best of the four.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Continuing with the current plan and monitoring is literally doing nothing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Only go to the sponsor for approvals or disapprovals, not for guidance on managing the project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. You can't just adjust the scope: it needs a change request (traditional) or the product owner (agile).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Not ideal, but the best of the four: act on the auditor's recommended corrective actions.

domande.spiegazione: This isn't a test of choosing the correct answer, it's choosing the best of the four. D isn't great, but it's 'the least sucky answer' and better than A, B and C, which you'd never do.
domande.nota: The instructor: 'the least of the suckiest answer'.
domande.motivo_incertezza: debatable: the instructor sees more than one valid answer

domande.domanda: A project manager is preparing to oversee the development of a new mobile application. During a stakeholder meeting, a senior executive expresses concern that the project may not align with the organization's strategic goals. The project manager needs to address this concern to ensure continued support and alignment. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Reassure the executive that the team is capable of delivering the project on time and within budget.
opzioni.B: Review the project's alignment with the strategic goals.
opzioni.C: Schedule a follow-up meeting with the executive to discuss the project benefits in more detail.
opzioni.D: Conduct a performance review of the project team to identify areas for improvement.

domande.hint: 'Next': check whether the concern is true before acting.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Simply reassuring is like saying 'it's aligned, don't worry about it': it's doing nothing.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Analyze whether the project is actually aligned with the strategic goals before taking any action.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. A good step, but after reviewing the alignment (B, then C).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The project hasn't really started yet: reviewing the team's performance makes no sense.

domande.spiegazione: Analyze before acting: first check whether the project is aligned with the strategic goals, then meet the executive to discuss.

domande.domanda: A project manager is working on a government infrastructure project that requires strict compliance with standards. During a routine review, the project manager discovers that some activities may not meet the required standards. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Halt all activities until a full compliance review is conducted.
opzioni.B: Update the project plan to include additional quality checks.
opzioni.C: Notify the regulatory authorities of the non-compliant activities.
opzioni.D: Conduct a root cause analysis to identify the reasons for non-compliance and implement corrective actions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. If the project were certainly breaking the law you might stop it, but for something that only might be happening, don't stop the project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Not yet: first analyze to know what the corrective actions should be.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Regulators would ask you to make sure before notifying them of potential non-compliance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Analyze why it is happening and then fix it.

domande.spiegazione: Watch the keywords: 'may not meet' means it isn't certain. If the project were doing something illegal (people could get hurt or someone could go to jail) you should stop it, but when something only might be happening, analyze it first and then correct it.

domande.domanda: During the construction of a new building, the project manager learns that unforeseen geological issues will significantly increase the cost beyond the approved budget. What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Adjust the timeline to reduce labor costs.
opzioni.B: Consult with a geological technician for a more cost-effective solution.
opzioni.C: Implement a phased construction approach.
opzioni.D: Analyze the situation, considering all possible options.

domande.hint: Two good answers: pick the more comprehensive one.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never adjust the timeline like that: it probably requires a change request.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. A good answer, but narrower: D includes this kind of consultation among all the options.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It's not clear how a phased approach would save money.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Analyzing the situation and all options is the most comprehensive answer and follows the mindset.

domande.spiegazione: Use the mindset: analyze before acting. B and D are both good, but D is more encompassing: it pulls in more than B does.

domande.domanda: As the project manager overseeing the rollout of a new IT system, you discover halfway through the fiscal year that several critical software enhancements funded by this year's budget will not be completed on schedule. These enhancements were initiated based on mid-year changes and are critical to the project's success. What should you do first?

opzioni.A: Initiate a review of the scope to identify areas for schedule acceleration.
opzioni.B: Collaborate with the team to assess the project deliverables and focus on the critical enhancements.
opzioni.C: Engage the sponsor to adjust expectations and secure support for extended timelines.
opzioni.D: Communicate the progress and the adjusted timelines for these enhancements to the finance department.

domande.hint: Who is best placed to tell you how to fix it?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Reviewing the scope for acceleration isn't something you can do by yourself: the team has to help you.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Work with the team: they are the best people to tell you how to implement a change and fix a problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The second-best answer, but the sponsor may not accept an extension.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. You can't work only with the finance department: you have to work with your customers.

domande.spiegazione: Who is best to tell you how to implement a change, fix something or solve a problem? The team. Start with them; engaging the sponsor comes second.

domande.domanda: In the midst of a major software development project, the project manager is preparing for an upcoming in-depth executive review. The project manager must show how the project's progress is being tracked and measured, since the executive team wants to understand how effectively the project is being managed. What should the project manager focus on in the presentation?

opzioni.A: Provide a detailed report on team productivity and individual contributions.
opzioni.B: Compile earned value management (EVM) metrics, including schedule variance (SV) and cost variance (CV), for a comprehensive review.
opzioni.C: Discuss the implementation of the new project management tool and its impact on project efficiency.
opzioni.D: Outline the risks encountered so far and the mitigation strategies.

domande.hint: What do we measure on a project? Time and money.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Productivity and individual contributions don't show how the project is being measured.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. EVM measures project performance on time and cost: SV and CV are exactly that.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. A new tool doesn't help measure and track progress.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Risks and mitigations aren't how progress is measured.

domande.spiegazione: A straightforward one if you know EVM: you don't need the formulas, but you need to know what SV and CV are. Measuring a project generally means measuring time and cost.

domande.domanda: ⚠️ While leading a new agile global environmental conservation project, the project manager oversees a diverse team distributed across several continents. Recognizing the diverse cultural backgrounds within the team, the project manager aims to foster unity and effective collaboration. What is the most effective action to enhance team integration? — ⚠️ Note: debatable: the instructor sees more than one valid answer.

opzioni.A: Organize a series of cross-cultural trainings for all team members to educate them about cultural differences.
opzioni.B: Set up a digital collaboration space for team members to share personal and professional updates.
opzioni.C: Arrange monthly face-to-face retreats.
opzioni.D: Encourage open communication and demonstrate confidence in the team's abilities and contributions.

domande.hint: The keyword is 'agile': servant leader and self-organizing team.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Not bad, but you are choosing the solution for the team; on an agile project let the team find its way.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. A collaboration space alone just hands the work to the team without real engagement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Monthly face-to-face retreats probably aren't feasible for a team spread across the globe.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. On an agile project the team is self-directing: step back, encourage open communication and trust the team's ability.

domande.spiegazione: Trick question. On an agile project you are a servant leader and the team is self-directing and self-managing. Sometimes you need to step back and let the team figure things out (intervening only if it gets out of hand), showing confidence in them rather than imposing your own solution.
domande.nota: The instructor hesitates between A and D, then explains D ('indeed').
domande.motivo_incertezza: debatable: the instructor sees more than one valid answer

domande.domanda: At the onset of a healthcare software upgrade project, the client emphasizes that the enhancements are critical to improving patient care and operational efficiency and could affect the provider's reputation and financial performance. The client is eager to see improvements implemented in the shortest time frame. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Use agile methodologies to ensure rapid delivery of high-priority features.
opzioni.B: Implement a waterfall method to automate testing.
opzioni.C: Establish a dedicated task force to focus on critical system upgrades first.
opzioni.D: Conduct a series of stakeholder workshops to prioritize the software enhancements based on impact.

domande.hint: A software project that has just started, where the client wants the most important things first.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Agile (especially Scrum) delivers the most important features first, as quickly as possible.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Waterfall takes the longest and doesn't give results in the shortest time.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Only the customer (the product owner) can say what is critical.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Prioritization is done by the product owner, not by you through workshops.

domande.spiegazione: The project is just starting and it's software development: it's ripe for agile, because the client wants to see the most important improvements first.

domande.domanda: In the middle of an urban development project, the project manager faces a setback: a key engineer and an urban planner announce their imminent departure from the team. The project is on a strict timeline with critical milestones approaching, and the remaining team members are concerned about the increased workload and the impact on the schedule. What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Increase the workload of the remaining team members to cover the tasks of the departing individuals.
opzioni.B: Outsource specific critical tasks to a specialized firm to keep the project on schedule.
opzioni.C: Work with the remaining team members to recruit new members to complete the workload.
opzioni.D: Apply for a project timeline extension due to the unforeseen staffing challenges.

domande.hint: Never overwork the team; involve them in the solution.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Never overwork anyone in any exam scenario, even if it may happen in real life.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. It might solve the problem, but not right away: it requires a full procurement process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Involve the team in the solution and work with them to recruit new members.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. An extension requires a change request: you can't simply apply for it.

domande.spiegazione: Common exam scenario: team members leave. Never overwork people. Let the team help you and involve them in the issue rather than figuring it out alone.

domande.domanda: A firm is planning to transition to lean development techniques. The project manager encounters resistance from several stakeholders worldwide who are wary of the new processes. The project manager needs to build confidence in lean methodologies among the stakeholders. What should the project manager propose?

opzioni.A: Schedule meetings with the stakeholders to address their concerns.
opzioni.B: Introduce a reward system for early adopters of lean techniques.
opzioni.C: Accept that lean development will not work in all companies.
opzioni.D: Organize a company-wide seminar on the history and principles of lean.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Meet them, find out exactly what they don't like and then explain the benefits.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. They already don't want it: a reward doesn't address their concern.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Accepting that it won't work is doing nothing, which is never the answer.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A seminar on history and principles doesn't address their specific concerns.

domande.spiegazione: If one of the choices is to do nothing, it's not the answer. Meet the stakeholders, understand their concerns and explain the benefits.

domande.domanda: Leading a significant initiative to overhaul a corporation's IT infrastructure, the project manager has successfully navigated several phases with the CTO overseeing the initiative. When the CTO unexpectedly departs, the incoming CTO pauses the initiative pending a comprehensive review of the project's alignment with the company's revised technological direction. What is the most effective first step for the project manager?

opzioni.A: Arrange a meeting with the new CTO to outline the project's benefits and strategic alignment.
opzioni.B: Prepare a detailed report comparing the current project status with industry standards and trends.
opzioni.C: Initiate a project audit to demonstrate compliance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
opzioni.D: Develop a contingency plan addressing potential changes requested by the new CTO.

domande.hint: A key stakeholder has left and a new one has arrived: what do you do first?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Meet the new person: understand what they want and explain what the project is about.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Possibly useful, but after meeting the new CTO.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Not yet: meet the person first.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Not yet: first understand what the new CTO actually wants.

domande.spiegazione: Common exam scenario: a major stakeholder leaves and a new one arrives. B, C and D aren't wrong and you may do them later, but the question asks what to do first: meet the new stakeholder (order: A, then B, then C).

domande.domanda: While estimating tasks for a major upgrade to an existing application, the project manager finds that the development team has different views on the effort required for a particularly challenging feature. What should the project manager do to synchronize these varying estimates?

opzioni.A: Suggest implementing a quick prototype to better gauge the necessary effort.
opzioni.B: Allow the team additional time to research and independently reassess their estimates.
opzioni.C: Ask each team member to detail their estimation process and foster a group consensus.
opzioni.D: Assign the task estimation to the most experienced developer to set a standard.

domande.hint: Team members disagree: bring them together.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. A prototype goes a little too far before letting the team work through it together.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. We don't want them to reassess independently: we want them to work it out together.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Each member explains how they got their estimate (maybe Bob doesn't understand Tom's) and the group reaches consensus.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Handing it to one person is like forcing a solution and cuts out the rest of the team.

domande.spiegazione: When team members can't agree on an estimate, bring them together so they understand each other's reasoning and reach consensus.

domande.domanda: During the rollout of a new e-commerce platform, an agile project manager observes customers moving to a competitor's site, which recently introduced a highly user-friendly checkout process. What is the first action the project manager should take?

opzioni.A: Engage in a detailed discussion with the product owner about recent customer feedback and shifts in market trends.
opzioni.B: Intensify development efforts on refining the existing features to make them more competitive.
opzioni.C: Pause the introduction of additional features to prioritize a complete overhaul.
opzioni.D: Add a new user-friendly checkout process.

domande.hint: Agile: who decides what goes into the product?

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Go to the product owner with the customer feedback: only the product owner can put it into the backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Deciding what to refine is not your call: that goes back to the product owner.
