domande.domanda:
During the sprint planning session, a Scrum team came across a disputable user story for which everyone had a different story point estimation. The product owner, being the most acquainted with the business case, weighed in with a “2” story point estimation. However, the Scrum master thinks it should be “3”, comparing it to similar previously completed stories. The cross-functional team thinks it should be assigned “5” story points.
Which estimate should be applied?

opzioni.A: 2, because the product owner is the most aware of the business
opzioni.B: 3, because the project manager has past experience that allows them to use the analogous estimation technique
opzioni.C: 5, because the team members are the ones who will be working on the story
opzioni.D: 3, as an average of all estimates

domande.spiegazione: Estimates should be provided by individuals who are assigned to do the work, such as the development team, and not by the product owner or the Scrum Master. (Essential Scrum by Rubin, Kenneth S, page 123).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a project using an iteration-based Agile approach. During the retrospective meeting, one of the team members stated that the sprint planning meeting always takes too long because tasks were not detailed enough in the first place.
What should the project manager do to fix this issue?

opzioni.A: Establish a rule that prohibits the creation of non-detailed tasks.
opzioni.B: Encourage the team to hold one or more backlog refinement sessions with the product owner during iterations.
opzioni.C: Ignore the team member’s feedback unless other members agree with them.
opzioni.D: Split the planning meeting into two or three sessions so attendees don’t feel bored.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Setting a restrictive rule for creating tasks will only prevent team members from adding tasks to the backlog.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Backlog refinement is used to prepare tasks and user stories for the upcoming iteration (Agile Practice Guide, page 52).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The team member’s declaration indicates that the team is not holding backlog refinement sessions at all, or they need to have more sessions. Hence, such feedback shouldn’t be ignored.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Dividing the planning meeting into shorter sessions is not going to solve the root cause of this issue.

domande.spiegazione: Backlog refinement is used to prepare tasks and user stories for the upcoming iteration (Agile Practice Guide, page 52).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is overseeing a product development program with three agile teams working on interconnected modules. Team A's progress is consistently blocked because they are waiting for critical API interfaces from Team B, which, in turn, is delayed by foundational components from Team C. This is causing significant delays and frustration across all teams.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Mandate that all three teams adopt a standardized definition of "done" to ensure consistency in their delivery pace.
opzioni.B: Create a visual dependency board and establish regular integration points.
opzioni.C: Instruct Team A to develop temporary, mock interfaces so they can proceed independently of Team B's delays.
opzioni.D: Recommend a re-baselining of the overall program schedule.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. While a consistent DoD is good practice, it does not directly solve the problem of technical and workflow dependencies between teams. Teams could each be producing "done" work independently, but if their pieces don't integrate, the overall product still fails. This treats a symptom (perceived inconsistency) rather than the root cause (unmanaged dependencies).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The scenario describes a classic case of dependency overload between teams. The recommended troubleshooting steps are to make dependencies visible on a board and agree on regular integration points. The project manager should first create transparency (the board) and then establish a rhythm for coordination (integration points), which is the most effective first step to untangle the interdependencies and restore flow.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Instruct Team A to develop temporary mock interfaces can be a short-term technical solution, but it is not the most effective first step. It only helps one team (Team A) and risks creating siloed work that may not integrate smoothly later, potentially causing more rework. The core problem is the lack of coordination between teams, which this option does not address.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Recommending a re-baselining of the overall program schedule is a reactive, command-and-control approach that should be a last resort. Doing this without first attempting collaborative, agile solutions undermines the team’s ability to self-manage and solve problems. Re-baselining the schedule merely documents the delay but does not implement any process changes to fix the underlying dependency issue.

domande.spiegazione: The scenario describes a classic case of dependency overload between teams. The recommended troubleshooting steps are to make dependencies visible on a board and agree on regular integration points. The project manager should first create transparency (the board) and then establish a rhythm for coordination (integration points), which is the most effective first step to untangle the interdependencies and restore flow.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is planning a project that consists of manufacturing a drone for wildlife protection purposes. The project is challenging because the drone is supposed to be able to identify and keep count of a wide range of wild animals. Since they have previously dealt with drones in the military field, the project manager thinks that using analogous estimating will be of great help for their current project.
This estimation technique is best known as:

opzioni.A: Three-point estimating
opzioni.B: Expert judgment estimating
opzioni.C: Bottom-up estimating
opzioni.D: Parametric estimating

domande.spiegazione: Expert judgment is judgment provided based upon expertise in an application area, discipline, industry, etc., as appropriate for the activity being performed. Such expertise may be provided by any group or person with specialized education, knowledge, skill, experience, or training (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 170). Expert judgment estimating is the use of specialized knowledge of an industry or previous similar experience in estimation. Likewise, analogous estimating uses parameters from similar previous projects. Since the project manager worked with drones before, they have gained enough experience to make them an expert and enable them to use analogous estimation.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a new project that uses GenAI to generate predictive models for disease outbreaks. The AI vendor offers a shortcut: using anonymized data from previous unrelated projects to accelerate the training of the model. This data was originally collected under consent agreements for different use cases.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Accept the vendor’s offer since the data is anonymized and could improve project outcomes.
opzioni.B: Request legal approval before proceeding and consult with the data privacy officer.
opzioni.C: Proceed with training the model and notify the sponsor afterward.
opzioni.D: Use the data and insert a disclaimer in the final project report to limit liability.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Accepting the vendor’s offer based only on anonymization ignores the consent scope. Ethical use of AI requires not just protecting identities, but also honoring the original data agreements. This undermines responsibility and honesty principles.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Requesting legal approval before proceeding and consulting with the data privacy officer reflects the project manager’s responsibility and respect principles as outlined in PMI’s Code of Ethics. Even anonymized data may be subject to specific consent terms. The PM must consult legal and privacy experts to ensure ethical, legal compliance, and stakeholder respect.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Proceeding without prior approval and only informing the sponsor later violates accountability and transparency principles. This is retroactive justification, not ethical decision-making.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. A disclaimer does not address the ethical violation. It tries to shift responsibility after a questionable action, which conflicts with the PMI values of responsibility and fairness.

domande.spiegazione: Requesting legal approval before proceeding and consulting with the data privacy officer reflects the project manager’s responsibility and respect principles as outlined in PMI’s Code of Ethics. Even anonymized data may be subject to specific consent terms. The PM must consult legal and privacy experts to ensure ethical, legal compliance, and stakeholder respect.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is approached by an organization to develop the resource planning for their new innovative project. Even though the project manager has worked with many similar organizations in the past, this time, they are skeptical about the project’s business model.
Should the project manager use historical information in this case?

opzioni.A: No, since every project is unique, there is rarely any correlation between different projects’ resource expectations.
opzioni.B: No, since historical information is usually not applicable to innovative and rapidly changing projects.
opzioni.C: Yes, since historical information can provide insight when making comparisons to resources used on previous similar projects.
opzioni.D: Yes, since an accurate estimation of resources cannot be performed without referring to historical information.

domande.spiegazione: Historical information can be helpful when developing analogous estimates or parametric estimates. Analogous estimating is usually less time-consuming and less costly than other techniques, such as bottom-up estimating, but it also tends to be less accurate (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 146-147).

domande.domanda:
In a software development company, the project manager is leading a cross-functional team of developers, designers, and testers on a high-profile project. The team works in a fast-paced Agile environment, relying heavily on various communication and collaboration technologies to facilitate their work. However, one team member is hearing impaired, which presents unique challenges in effectively utilizing these technologies.
What should the project manager do to adapt the used work technologies and ensure seamless collaboration for all team members?

opzioni.A: Implement real-time transcription services or captioning tools during virtual meetings and conference calls to provide accurate text-based representations of spoken content.
opzioni.B: Conduct regular training sessions for team members on effective communication strategies and techniques when interacting with individuals with hearing impairments.
opzioni.C: Explore alternative communication channels, such as instant messaging platforms or email, to supplement verbal exchanges and ensure that important information is conveyed effectively to the concerned team member.
opzioni.D: Establish a buddy system within the team where a designated team member is paired with the concerned team member to provide additional support and assistance during meetings and discussions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Implementing real-time transcription services or captioning tools during virtual meetings and conference calls addresses the need to adapt the work technologies used. This approach ensures that the team member with hearing impairment can access accurate text-based representations of spoken content, thereby promoting a culture of inclusivity and support for diverse communication needs (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 212).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Training sessions can take time to implement and may not provide immediate solutions. Additionally, expecting other team members to consistently adjust their communication styles may not be practical or sustainable in a fast-paced Agile environment.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Relying on written communication methods may not fully address the concerned team member's need for real-time access to information and participation in team discussions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Establishing a buddy system may single the team member out or draw attention to his hearing impairment, potentially making him feel uncomfortable or different from the rest of the team.

domande.spiegazione: Implementing real-time transcription services or captioning tools during virtual meetings and conference calls addresses the need to adapt the work technologies used. This approach ensures that the team member with hearing impairment can access accurate text-based representations of spoken content, thereby promoting a culture of inclusivity and support for diverse communication needs (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 212).

domande.domanda:
During a sprint review meeting, a team member demonstrated a new feature and pointed out that it took longer than expected due to missing technical documentation. Then, the team member asked a senior member how to avoid this in the future.
What should the meeting facilitator do?

opzioni.A: Let the discussion flow naturally since it’s important, and only intervene if the side discussion continues for too long.
opzioni.B: Ask the team member to reflect on how to make such improvements at another meeting.
opzioni.C: Interrupt the team member because the product owner is not supposed to know that the documentation is missing.
opzioni.D: Let the discussion continue, and then ask the product owner to give feedback on potential improvements.

domande.spiegazione: The retrospective meeting is the right meeting to reflect on what happened during the sprint and how to improve the implemented processes (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 194-195). Therefore, rather than discussing how to improve future work efficiency, the meeting facilitator should steer back the discussion to only focus on the demonstrated feature and get the product owner’s feedback on what has been produced. This being said, if the documentation needs improvement, team members should create a technical task for it and demonstrate its importance to the product owner during Sprint Planning.

domande.domanda:
Senior management of a financial firm launches a new project to renovate their office building. Five months into the project, the project manager is asked to attend a meeting with senior management to explain the multiple delays the project is suffering. Since the beginning of the execution phase, the project manager encountered several delays from the contracted construction team responsible for various site preparation, foundation laying, and structural construction. At the start, these delays did not have a considerable impact on the project. However, lately, the contractor’s delays have the potential to jeopardize the project's successful completion within the agreed-upon schedule.
What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Implement contractual penalties since delays are recurring to incentivize adherence to project timelines and mitigate the impact of these delays on the project schedule.
opzioni.B: Collaborate with the contractor to identify the root causes of the delays and develop strategies to mitigate and recover lost time.
opzioni.C: Terminate the contract and engage alternative vendors or subcontractors to complete the remaining project work, ensuring that project timelines are not compromised.
opzioni.D: Seek the support and guidance of senior management in resolving the delays and minimizing their impact on the overall project objectives, since senior management has a high level of interest in this project.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. While contractual penalties can be a form of motivation for the contractor to adhere to project timelines, they may not always be the most effective approach. Additionally, penalties may strain the contractor-client relationship and hinder collaboration and problem-solving efforts. This option might be considered when collaboration fails.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Collaborating with the contractor to identify the root causes of the delays and developing strategies to mitigate and recover lost time aligns with being proactive when it comes to issue resolution and collaborative problem-solving. It emphasizes the importance of communication and collaboration with project stakeholders to address project challenges effectively (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 156-157).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Terminating the contract and engaging alternative vendors or subcontractors may seem like a quick solution to address delays. However, this approach can introduce additional risks and complexities to the project, such as delays in onboarding new contractors, potential legal disputes, and variations in work quality or standards. Terminating contracts should be considered as a last resort after exhausting all other options.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. While escalating the issue of contractor delays to senior management or relevant stakeholders can be necessary in some cases, it should not be the first step taken by the project manager. Seeking the support and guidance of senior management to resolve this issue refers to escalation. This should only occur after the project manager has exhausted all other options for resolving the delays at the project level.

domande.spiegazione: Collaborating with the contractor to identify the root causes of the delays and developing strategies to mitigate and recover lost time aligns with being proactive when it comes to issue resolution and collaborative problem-solving. It emphasizes the importance of communication and collaboration with project stakeholders to address project challenges effectively (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 156-157).

domande.domanda:
All stakeholders are in a meeting to discuss a new project that is expected to start within one month and to last at least 10 iterations. One of the stakeholders mentions that someone should take the responsibility of developing and maintaining the product roadmap.
Who should take this responsibility?

opzioni.A: Project Manager
opzioni.B: Development Team
opzioni.C: Scrum Master
opzioni.D: Product Owner

domande.spiegazione: In agile, the product owner should be in charge of managing the product roadmap since they are responsible for the product’s success. The Product Owner’s primary responsibility is to represent the business, which involves the creation and maintenance of the Product Vision and Roadmap, as well as the Product Backlog.

domande.domanda:
A project manager sits with a key team member to understand why they’ve been frustrated lately. The team member explains that mistakes made by a certain coworker impacted his work, making him fall behind schedule unprecedentedly. The project manager explains to the team member that she is aware of the situation and that all of his hard work is noticed and appreciated.
What conflict resolution technique did the project manager use?

opzioni.A: Smoothing
opzioni.B: Compromising
opzioni.C: Collaborating
opzioni.D: Forcing

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The project manager used the smoothing technique. This method is characterized by giving more consideration to one side of the conflict over the other in an attempt to smooth out the situation and avoid making the conflict more intense. The project manager is downplaying the seriousness of the issue by reassuring the key team member. This technique often leads to establishing harmony and prevents any amplification of non-critical issues (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 157).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. This does not imply any compromise since the other side of the conflict was not involved nor partially satisfied.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. It is not a collaboration either since the project manager didn’t incorporate different views, nor did they reach a consensus.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. This can’t be considered forcing since no decisions or solutions were enforced.

domande.spiegazione: The project manager used the smoothing technique. This method is characterized by giving more consideration to one side of the conflict over the other in an attempt to smooth out the situation and avoid making the conflict more intense. The project manager is downplaying the seriousness of the issue by reassuring the key team member. This technique often leads to establishing harmony and prevents any amplification of non-critical issues (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 157).

domande.domanda:
After checking the burndown chart, a project manager finds out that there is a lot of work left to be done that will be difficult to complete by the end of the sprint.
What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Request an urgent meeting with the team and inform them that they will need to work overtime to meet the sprint deadline and keep the client satisfied.
opzioni.B: Send an email to the team informing them of the situation and encouraging them to put in more effort.
opzioni.C: Wait for the next standup meeting to find out the reason behind the team’s slow pace.
opzioni.D: Wait until the next retrospective meeting to reflect on what is happening.

domande.spiegazione:
As a servant leader, the project manager should remove any impediments facing their team. Listening to their updates and trying to detect if there are any blockers causing their slow work pace is the best course of action amidst an ongoing sprint (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 90).
Options A & B: The project manager shouldn’t ask the team to work overtime or send them an email as a formal way of putting them under pressure (Agile Practice Guide, page 35).
Option D: In order to improve processes, and as a second step, the project manager can raise the issue during the retrospective meeting; this could involve improving estimations, performance, documentation, etc.

domande.domanda:
A sponsor submitted a change request to the Change Control Board (CCB) of which the project manager is a member. The Board consists of five members, and their opinions diverged concerning whether to accept or reject the change request.
What is the best course of action in order to make a decision?

opzioni.A: Try to reach a consensus.
opzioni.B: Call for voting and let the majority decide.
opzioni.C: Let the most experienced member of the board decide.
opzioni.D: Let the board director decide.

domande.spiegazione: Collaboration is the best approach to resolving a conflict between members. This would involve an open dialogue where differing viewpoints and insights are exhibited and discussed to eventually reach a consensus and commit to the final decision (PMBOK 8th edition, page 157).

domande.domanda:
During the project planning phase, stakeholders insisted that their conflicting requirements should all be considered and consolidated. That made it hard for the project manager to create a plan that satisfied all stakeholders.
What should the project manager do to establish a common ground?

opzioni.A: Build focus groups involving concerned stakeholders to discuss and resolve conflicting interests.
opzioni.B: Create a document explaining the different perspectives and ask conflicting stakeholders to review it.
opzioni.C: Give each stakeholder the opportunity to write their requirements, and then merge all documents to create the project scope statement.
opzioni.D: Use the project manager’s legitimate power to decide which requirements should be prioritized.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Focus groups bring together stakeholders and subject matter experts to interactively discuss and learn about their expectations and attitudes towards a proposed service, product, or result (PMBOK 8th edition, page 171).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. While documenting perspectives is useful for capturing requirements, it does not actively engage stakeholders in resolving conflicts.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Merging inputs without addressing conflicts can result in a scope with unresolved contradictions. Dialogue and collaboration are essential for reconciling differences.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Unilateral decision-making risks alienating stakeholders and failing to address critical concerns.

domande.spiegazione: Focus groups bring together stakeholders and subject matter experts to interactively discuss and learn about their expectations and attitudes towards a proposed service, product, or result (PMBOK 8th edition, page 171).

domande.domanda:
A project manager has just joined a new organization. A majority of the organization’s projects are conducted by experienced project managers.
What should be the primary focus of the new project manager?

opzioni.A: Acquire a skillful team.
opzioni.B: Learn about the organization’s culture.
opzioni.C: Get to know the organization’s executive managers.
opzioni.D: Get to know the organization’s project managers.

domande.spiegazione: When joining a new organization, it is very important that the project manager grasps the organization’s culture. Although talking to executive managers and project managers may help in this matter, understanding the culture, i.e., how the organization operates, its policies, and its appetite for risk, among other things, should be the project manager’s priority when joining a new organization.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is managing a national book fair. Early in the planning phase, the project manager identified some low-impact risks.
What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Ignore the risks since their impact is fairly low.
opzioni.B: Add the risks to the risk register and keep monitoring them.
opzioni.C: Develop a detailed risk response.
opzioni.D: Report the risks to the project sponsor.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Ignoring risks, even low-impact ones, is not a good practice. Unmonitored risks can escalate or combine with other factors, leading to unexpected challenges.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Passive risk acceptance is an appropriate approach for low-impact risks. No proactive action is needed for passive acceptance other than periodically reviewing the threat to ensure that it is not signiﬁcantly changing (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 204).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. A detailed risk response is unnecessary for low-impact risks. Allocating resources to address minor risks prematurely can divert attention and resources from higher-priority issues.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Reporting low-impact risks to the project sponsor may be unnecessary unless they escalate and impact critical deliverables. Sponsors are typically more concerned with high-impact risks or significant changes to the project scope, budget, or timeline.

domande.spiegazione: Passive risk acceptance is an appropriate approach for low-impact risks. No proactive action is needed for passive acceptance other than periodically reviewing the threat to ensure that it is not signiﬁcantly changing (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 204).

domande.domanda:
A project manager has taken over the management of a project, replacing the project manager who has quit. At the beginning of the execution phase, the project manager notices that team members have different opinions concerning project work and deliverables, as well as the overall complexity level.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Avoid intervening to allow the team enough time to get familiar with the project scope.
opzioni.B: Identify and assess potential risks caused by this divergence of opinion, then develop a plan to manage and respond to these risks.
opzioni.C: Organize a meeting involving all team members to identify and resolve misunderstandings in order to avoid issues, disintegration, and rework.
opzioni.D: Talk to each team member separately to explain the project requirements.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The withdrawal technique should not be used in critical conflicts related to project work and deliverables, like in this scenario.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Planning risks is supposed to take place in the planning phase. But, since the project is in the execution phase, the project manager needs to follow the established plan and resolve any occurring risks, pre-identified or not. A change request can be issued to manage an impactful risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The best course of action in this case is to use problem-solving or collaboration techniques to resolve this issue. Therefore, in order to avoid any future problems, disintegration, or rework, organizing meetings is the best option to identify and resolve misunderstandings among team members.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The best communication method is interactive face-to-face communication; that’s why talking to each team member individually isn’t as effective as gathering all team members in one meeting so they can interact with each other.

domande.spiegazione: The best course of action in this case is to use problem-solving or collaboration techniques to resolve this issue. Therefore, in order to avoid any future problems, disintegration, or rework, organizing meetings is the best option to identify and resolve misunderstandings among team members.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading the launch of a new e-commerce platform that includes hardware procurement, supplier coordination, and software development. During project planning, the project team identified several potential threats, including power outages, supplier reliability issues, and software defects. Discussing several potential risk responses, the team agreed to mitigate most of the identified risks.
What should the project manager do next? (Select three answers)

opzioni.A: Choose a supplier who has impressive customer reviews of its service.
opzioni.B: Ensure that the new server comes with a guarantee.
opzioni.C: Ensure that the office facility has a backup generator.
opzioni.D: Carry out more tests on the product before it’s released.

domande.spiegazione:
A. Selecting a supplier based on verified positive customer feedback mitigates the threat of poor service or delivery delays. This proactive measure reduces the likelihood of supplier-related issues by leveraging historical performance data rather than relying on untested vendors.
C. Implementing backup power infrastructure mitigates the threat of operational downtime during outages. This solution reduces the impact of power interruptions by ensuring the continuity of critical systems. Unlike insurance (which transfers risk), the generator actively diminishes the consequences of an adverse event, making it a classic mitigation strategy for infrastructure risks.
D. Increasing pre-release testing efforts mitigates the threat of defects reaching production. More comprehensive testing identifies and resolves issues earlier, reducing both the probability and potential severity of post-launch failures. This exemplifies mitigation through enhanced quality control processes (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 204).
Option B: A warranty transfers responsibility for hardware defects to the manufacturer but doesn't decrease the chance of defects occurring. This represents risk transfer through contractual means, not mitigation through proactive system improvements or safeguards (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 204).

domande.domanda:
A project manager working in a strong matrix organization overhears two team members expressing their desire to work together on the next project since the current project is in its closing phase. These two members have collaborated effectively in the current project, believing that their synergy would benefit future projects as well.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Acknowledge the team members' preferences and assign them to work together on the next project, considering their past collaboration and synergy.
opzioni.B: Assess the next project resource needs and assign team members based on their alignment with project objectives.
opzioni.C: Encourage team members to submit formal requests to management, indicating their preferred project assignments for consideration in future projects.
opzioni.D: Consult with functional managers to check resource availability before making any decisions.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Even if their synergy and positive team dynamic can promote the project's success, the project manager should first consider the project requirements before acting on the team members' preferences.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Team members' assignments should be first and foremost based on the project’s needs and requirements.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Encouraging team members to submit formal requests to management overlooks the project manager's role in proactively managing resources. The project manager should only escalate matters to upper management when they’re beyond his power.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Consulting with functional managers is an important aspect of project resource management. However, this step is unnecessary since this scenario involves a strong matrix organization in which the balance of power is on the side of the project manager, meaning the project manager doesn’t have to consult with the functional manager to check resource availability before making decisions.

domande.spiegazione: Team members' assignments should be first and foremost based on the project’s needs and requirements.

domande.domanda:
During a prospect meeting, the client insisted that the new website they want to develop must meet some crucial conditions: it must be SEO (Search Engine Optimization) friendly, with a score of 80% or above, and all of its pages must be responsive on all devices and screen sizes.
The client is setting the website’s __________________.

opzioni.A: Definition of Done
opzioni.B: Quality Assurance
opzioni.C: Functional Requirements
opzioni.D: Fit for Use

domande.spiegazione:
A Definition of Done is a checklist of required criteria in order to consider a product ready for delivery (Agile Practice Guide, page 151 & PMBOK 8th Edition, page 39).
Option C: Functional requirements describe the product requirements, e.g., website menus, functionalities, services, etc. (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 130).
Option D: Fit for Use is when a product serves its purpose as it is usable in its current state.

domande.domanda:
While inspecting the construction work progress, a project manager discovered that their team had forgotten to install the solar panel on the roof, which had already been completed. The house was expected to be delivered by the end of the month, but this error could result in a delay of one to two days.
What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Notify the house owner of the omission and the expected delay.
opzioni.B: Find out how the omission occurred to avoid having similar issues in the future.
opzioni.C: Submit a change request to the house owner.
opzioni.D: Study alternatives with the project team to deliver the house on time.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The project manager should first explore ways to resolve the issue and minimize or avoid the delay before informing the owner.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The project manager should address the immediate problem of meeting the current delivery deadline before thinking of future prevention.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. A change request should be the last resort after alternatives have been explored. A change request involves modifying the scope, cost, or timeline, which may not be necessary if a resolution is found.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The project manager should confront the issue and try to resolve it with their team in order to deliver the project on time.

domande.spiegazione: The project manager should confront the issue and try to resolve it with their team in order to deliver the project on time.

domande.domanda:
A senior manager has informed the project manager that she will be in charge of leading a Fintech (Financial Technology) project. However, after a few weeks, the project manager starts to feel worried because every time she inquires about the project’s start date, the senior manager says that he is waiting for an official document to be issued in order to start working on the project.
Which document is the senior manager referring to?

opzioni.A: Project charter
opzioni.B: Project management plan
opzioni.C: Scope statement
opzioni.D: Enterprise resource planning

domande.spiegazione:
The project charter is the document that authorizes the project manager to launch the project execution (PMBOK 8th edition, page 125). It also includes a brief description of the project and its requirements.
Options B & C: Both the scope statement and the project management plan contain a detailed version of these requirements.

domande.domanda:
In a new project of an online exam application development, the project manager encounters an indifferent stakeholder who holds a significant share in the company but shows little interest in project progress, showing up late or missing most meetings. Despite the project manager’s repeated attempts to engage the stakeholder in critical discussions and decision-making processes, the stakeholder remains unresponsive and disengaged from the project.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Focus efforts on engaging with the more responsive stakeholders who actively contribute to project progress and decision-making.
opzioni.B: Document the stakeholder's lack of engagement and discuss the matter with senior management to seek guidance.
opzioni.C: Meet with the indifferent stakeholder to express concerns about their disinterest and demand their active participation in project discussions and decision-making processes.
opzioni.D: Initiate a stakeholder analysis to tailor communication strategies and engagement approaches that resonate with the stakeholder's preferences and priorities.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Focusing efforts on engaging with the more responsive stakeholders who actively contribute to project progress and decision-making suggests ignoring the indifferent stakeholder, meaning overlooking the indifferent stakeholder’s needs and concerns, which will only result in the latter’s dissatisfaction. Ignoring stakeholders, even if they appear indifferent, can undermine project success and stakeholder relationships.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Documenting the stakeholder's lack of engagement and escalating the issue to senior management should be considered a last resort after exhausting efforts to engage with the stakeholder directly and seeking to understand their reasons for disengagement.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Confronting the indifferent stakeholder directly may create tension and negatively impact the stakeholder relationship. It could result in further disengagement or resistance from the stakeholder, leading to conflicts. It’s important to foster positive stakeholder relationships and address issues collaboratively rather than resorting to confrontational approaches.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Initiating a stakeholder analysis to identify the indifferent stakeholder's interests, expectations, and potential impact on the project can help the project manager tailor his communication strategies and engagement approaches to resonate with the stakeholder's preferences and priorities (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 199-200).

domande.spiegazione: Initiating a stakeholder analysis to identify the indifferent stakeholder's interests, expectations, and potential impact on the project can help the project manager tailor his communication strategies and engagement approaches to resonate with the stakeholder's preferences and priorities (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 199-200).

domande.domanda:
After completing all requirements, the project manager sits with the product manager to go over each item of the deliverable acceptance criteria. The product manager found that among thirty deliverables, two did not meet requirements, so she asked the project manager to make the necessary changes before signing off on the final delivery document.
Which process are they both currently performing?

opzioni.A: Manage Quality Assurance
opzioni.B: Monitor and Control scope
opzioni.C: Validate scope
opzioni.D: Close project

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The Manage Quality Assurance process involves ensuring processes are performed in a manner consistent with stakeholder expectations, involving the implementation of planned and systematic activities defined in the project’s quality management plan (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 16).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Monitor and Control scope is the process of monitoring the status of the project and product scope, managing changes to the scope baseline, measuring the quality of the deliverables, and ensuring fulfillment of the required standards (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 40).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. During the Validate scope process, deliverables are compared against the acceptance criteria and requirements in order to formally sign off on the completed deliverables (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 44).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Close Project or Phase is the process of finalizing all activities related to the project or phase, including archiving knowledge, completing planned work, and releasing resources for new projects or operations (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 17).

domande.spiegazione: During the Validate scope process, deliverables are compared against the acceptance criteria and requirements in order to formally sign off on the completed deliverables (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 44).

domande.domanda:
A project manager has just started a two-year project with team members from different locations and cultures. After attending a webinar about the power of motivation, the project manager decided to set a reward strategy for their project team.
Which of the following reward strategies would be the most convenient for their project? (Select two)

opzioni.A: Set a reward for the project team every 6 months.
opzioni.B: Set a reward for the project team at the end of the project.
opzioni.C: Consider cultural differences when determining rewards.
opzioni.D: Cultural differences should not be considered when setting up a reward strategy, as they have no substantial impact.

domande.spiegazione: Project managers should demonstrate their acknowledgment and recognition to their team members throughout the project life cycle rather than waiting till its end to do so. Moreover, cultural differences should be taken into consideration when determining rewards since recognition and rewards can be perceived differently based on various cultural factors (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 192).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is assigned to a new high-tech complex project to develop smart contact lenses. During the project planning phase, the project manager identified some financial constraints as well as a significant threat related to potential delays in receiving regulatory approvals for the product. Despite proactive efforts to expedite the approval process, there is still a possibility that the approvals may not be obtained on time, which could lead to project delays.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Mitigate the risk by collaborating with regulatory authorities, submitting comprehensive documentation, and proactively addressing any identified concerns to expedite the approval process.
opzioni.B: Delegate the risk to a third-party organization or contractor who specializes in navigating regulatory requirements and has the resources and expertise to expedite the approval process.
opzioni.C: Accept the risk as an inherent aspect of the project and continue with the current plan without implementing any specific risk response.
opzioni.D: Avoid the risk of delays in regulatory approvals by redesigning the product or altering the project scope to eliminate the need for regulatory approval altogether.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Implementing risk mitigation strategies is the proactive approach to addressing the potential delays in regulatory approvals; through collaboration and comprehensive documentation, the project team can minimize the likelihood and impact of this threat.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Since the project already has financial constraints, hiring a third-party organization could only increase costs further. This course of action can also introduce dependencies and potential challenges associated with coordinating with external partners.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Accepting significant threats can jeopardize project success, so it is not advisable. Acceptance without any mitigation efforts may lead to project delays, cost overruns, or other negative consequences.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Redesigning the product may not be practical or feasible in all situations, as it could introduce additional complexities. Additionally, it may not fully address the underlying risk of regulatory delays, as there may still be regulatory requirements or approvals needed for the revised project scope.

domande.spiegazione: Implementing risk mitigation strategies is the proactive approach to addressing the potential delays in regulatory approvals; through collaboration and comprehensive documentation, the project team can minimize the likelihood and impact of this threat.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is assigned to an amusement park project. The project comprises two phases: the first phase involves importing attractions like games and rides, and the second entails setting up and installing everything.
What should the project manager do after completing the first phase?

opzioni.A: Validate scope
opzioni.B: Identify risks
opzioni.C: Identify stakeholders
opzioni.D: Define activities

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Since the first phase was complete, this means the scope has already been validated.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Risks are identified early on in the project. Nonetheless, you should keep monitoring and identifying new risks throughout the project execution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The “Identify stakeholders” process should take place either before or concurrently with creating and approving the project charter. Stakeholders’ identification should be carried out as many times as needed. However, it should always be executed at the beginning of each project phase and whenever a significant change occurs on both the project and the organization level (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 71).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Likewise, activities are determined during the planning stage of each project phase, unless you’re employing the rolling wave technique or adopting other life cycles rather than the traditional approach, which is not the case in this situation.

domande.spiegazione: The “Identify stakeholders” process should take place either before or concurrently with creating and approving the project charter. Stakeholders’ identification should be carried out as many times as needed. However, it should always be executed at the beginning of each project phase and whenever a significant change occurs on both the project and the organization level (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 71).

domande.domanda:
A government agency assigned a project manager to initiate a project to digitize its paper-based licensing process. The current process relies heavily on walk-in service counters and physical approvals, which often cause delays and public complaints.
What should the project manager do first to ensure the project delivers value?

opzioni.A: Develop the communications management plan to keep the public informed.
opzioni.B: Meet with key stakeholders to agree on what the new digital process should look like and how it differs from the current process.
opzioni.C: Begin gathering system requirements based on templates from previous government IT projects.
opzioni.D: Choose an IT vendor to start designing the digital platform.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Communication is important, but before informing the public, internal alignment on the value and direction of change is needed.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The project manager should meet with key stakeholders to agree on what the new digital process should look like and how it differs from the current process. Understanding the current and future states is essential to delivering organizational value. This defines the purpose and expected benefits of the project (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 7 & 176-177).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Starting with predefined requirements can lead to misalignment with actual needs. Requirements should come after stakeholders agree on the desired outcomes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Starting technical work without stakeholder alignment can result in missed objectives and resistance to change.

domande.spiegazione: The project manager should meet with key stakeholders to agree on what the new digital process should look like and how it differs from the current process. Understanding the current and future states is essential to delivering organizational value. This defines the purpose and expected benefits of the project (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 7 & 176-177).

domande.domanda: A company has been awarded a contract in one of the Scandinavian countries. Before moving along with the team to the project site, which proactive measure should the project manager take?

opzioni.A: Educate the project team about the country’s laws.
opzioni.B: Teach the project team the country’s common slang terms.
opzioni.C: Raise the project team’s awareness of the cultural differences.
opzioni.D: Develop a communications management plan.

domande.spiegazione:
Understanding cultural differences is the first step toward effective communication, which entails reducing misunderstandings and enhancing communication skills (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 162).
Option D: A communications management plan should be developed after understanding the aspects and characteristics of this culture.

domande.domanda:
A company provides an open workspace as a way of fostering team collaboration. However, while managing an agile software project, a senior developer approached the project manager to request a separate office where she could better focus on her work since she was unable to carry out some critical tasks in the common team area.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Convince the senior developer of the advantages of working in the same space as her colleagues.
opzioni.B: Move the senior developer to a separate cubicle.
opzioni.C: Allow the senior developer to work in a separate area until her complex tasks are solved.
opzioni.D: Ask the whole team not to make noise, as it might disturb others.

domande.spiegazione: Companies that go for a “Caves and Common” office design (“Caves” refers to private spaces such as separate offices or cubicles, and “Common” refers to common work areas) allow their agile team members to temporarily work in quiet separate areas if they are unable to concentrate in the common open area. However, once they have finished the work at hand, they should return to the common team space (Agile Practice Guide, page 46).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a business transformation project. As part of the project scope, a survey with 10 experts has to be conducted. During project execution, the project sponsor asked to raise the number of experts to 20, explaining that 10 experts might not provide enough input and insight. The sponsor also requested making this adjustment without issuing a change request.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Proceed with the change, considering it will enhance project quality.
opzioni.B: Accept the sponsor's request to double the number of experts and document it in the project's meeting minutes for future reference.
opzioni.C: Proceed with surveying 20 experts and reduce the depth of each interview to keep the total effort and cost the same as the original plan.
opzioni.D: Inform the sponsor that they need to follow the change management process.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Even if the change seems minor or beneficial, implementing it without formal approval violates the project’s change control procedures and undermines governance.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Accepting the sponsor's request to double the number of experts and document it in the project's meeting minutes for future reference violates the core principle of integrated change control and bypasses the formal change request process. The minutes are not a substitute for a change log.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Proceeding with surveying 20 experts and reducing the depth of each interview is a form of "scope creep" that attempts to absorb the change without appearing to impact the budget. However, it unilaterally alters the project's scope and quality. The original requirement was likely for a certain depth of insight, which would be compromised. This sacrifices quality and potentially the validity of the survey results without formal approval, failing to meet the project's objectives.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Any change to the project management plan should go through the organization’s change control process by issuing a change request.

domande.spiegazione: Any change to the project management plan should go through the organization’s change control process by issuing a change request.

domande.domanda:
A project manager of a distressed project had been replaced by a new one. While the new project manager was examining the network diagram, they found five critical paths and two near-critical paths.
What does this indicate about the project?

opzioni.A: The project is at a high risk.
opzioni.B: The project requires more financial or human resources.
opzioni.C: The project will be completed on time and within budget.
opzioni.D: The project should be terminated.

domande.spiegazione:
According to the network diagram, the project is at high risk. With five critical paths and two near-critical paths, any delay of any activity belonging to these paths will result in the whole project’s delay.
Option B: Having more than one critical and near-critical path does not mean that the project requires more resources and an increase in the allocated budget.
Option D: Just because the project is at high risk of schedule delay does not mean it should be terminated.

domande.domanda:
An organization has recently converted to Agile. After a few months, the project manager’s supervisors complained that Team A was performing poorly because it always had a lower velocity than Team B.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Move some of Team B’s best performers to Team A.
opzioni.B: Set up a reward program to motivate Team A.
opzioni.C: Encourage Team A to increase their velocity in the upcoming sprints.
opzioni.D: Inform the supervisors that they can’t compare the performance of different teams based on their velocity.

domande.spiegazione: An agile team decides how many story points to tackle based on their own estimations, which can be different across teams. Thus, velocity can’t be used to compare the performance of different teams.

domande.domanda:
A remote-first company is holding an annual one-week retreat in an exotic country. For this year’s retreat, the project manager has been asked to take charge of the program planning. In order to quickly generate ideas, the project manager sends a form to all attendees asking for suggestions before holding a group creativity session to further discuss ideas.
What technique is the project manager using?

opzioni.A: Brainwriting
opzioni.B: Brainstorming
opzioni.C: Survey
opzioni.D: Mind mapping

domande.spiegazione: Brainwriting (aka individual brainstorming) is a refinement of the brainstorming technique that grants participants time to reflect on the questions individually, either on paper or online, before the whole group participates in a creativity session (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 149). This technique allows the participants to be better prepared, making the meeting or the creativity session more effective than a traditional brainstorming session would be.

domande.domanda:
A software startup uses a hybrid structure, combining an Agile co-located team for development with a virtual network of offshore QA testers. The project manager notices that the project team repeatedly misses the iterations’ deadlines due to time-zone misalignment.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Move all QA team members in-house under a project-oriented structure.
opzioni.B: Implement overlapping work hours and asynchronous collaboration tools.
opzioni.C: Ask the QA team members to adopt the Agile co-located team’s time zone.
opzioni.D: Remove QA tasks from the critical path.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Moving all QA in-house under a project-oriented structure overrides the hybrid structure’s cost/benefit balance since offshore QA may be opted for in the first place for being a cost-effective solution.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The project manager must adapt to low-to-moderate resource availability and decentralized teams by implementing overlapping work hours and asynchronous collaboration tools; this solution respects the virtual structure’s constraints while improving coordination. The Agile Practice Guide recommends defined communication protocols for distributed teams, including tools like Slack or Jira for synced updates.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Asking the QA team to adopt the Agile team’s time zone is unrealistic and disregards the principles of fair treatment as defined in the PMI Code of Ethics and Professional Conduct.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Removing QA tasks from the critical path can compromise the quality of project deliverables; QA is essential in Agile’s "Definition of Done" criteria (Scrum Guide).

domande.spiegazione: The project manager must adapt to low-to-moderate resource availability and decentralized teams by implementing overlapping work hours and asynchronous collaboration tools; this solution respects the virtual structure’s constraints while improving coordination. The Agile Practice Guide recommends defined communication protocols for distributed teams, including tools like Slack or Jira for synced updates.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is mentoring a team member to become a project manager themselves in the future. Before having a meeting with a prospective seller, the project manager asked the team member to facilitate the meeting.
What should the team member do to appropriately play the facilitator role?

opzioni.A: Take the project manager’s side in whatever decisions they make.
opzioni.B: Ensure the proper running of the meeting while remaining neutral.
opzioni.C: Get involved in the negotiations with the seller to help the project manager get a good deal.
opzioni.D: Ignore team members who are texting during the meeting.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. A facilitator should also help attendees collaborate and reach a consensus regarding decisions without taking sides.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Properly facilitating the meeting entails remaining neutral.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Therefore, they should not participate in negotiations with the potential provider.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. While facilitating a meeting, the team member should also make sure everyone stays on topic and participates in the conversation.

domande.spiegazione: Properly facilitating the meeting entails remaining neutral.

domande.domanda:
During the sprint retrospective meeting, the project team suggested improving communication and collaboration by using fishbowl windows and remote pairing. Despite the project manager’s concern that this might negatively impact the team’s productivity, the project manager agrees to implement both tools in order to promote self-organization within the team.
What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: At the end of the following sprint, the project manager and the project team should evaluate the impact of the new practices.
opzioni.B: The project manager should frequently join the remote conference rooms to ensure that the project team is actually working and not wasting time chit-chatting.
opzioni.C: The project manager should measure the team’s velocity during the following sprint, and in case of any decrease, the project manager should discontinue the use of the new practices.
opzioni.D: The project manager should ask for the product owner’s approval to use these two practices.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Following the new practices’ implementation, the project manager and the team need to verify any performance improvements or deteriorations during the next sprint retrospective so the team can further adjust and reflect on the process. Evaluating the impact could be done by checking the burndown or burnup charts, measuring velocity, comparing the sprint performance to previous sprints, etc.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The project manager should act as a servant leader, which means they shouldn’t control their team by frequently joining the conference rooms.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The project manager should not make unilateral decisions.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The product owner should respect the self-organizing nature of the Agile team and not intervene in their work processes.

domande.spiegazione: Following the new practices’ implementation, the project manager and the team need to verify any performance improvements or deteriorations during the next sprint retrospective so the team can further adjust and reflect on the process. Evaluating the impact could be done by checking the burndown or burnup charts, measuring velocity, comparing the sprint performance to previous sprints, etc.

domande.domanda:
A project manager asked the project team to perform benchmarking, brainstorming sessions, focus groups, interviews, and questionnaires.
What are these tools and techniques used for?

opzioni.A: Data analysis
opzioni.B: Data gathering
opzioni.C: Data representation
opzioni.D: Decision making

domande.spiegazione:
In this scenario, the project is currently in the Elicit and Analyze Requirements process, which involves determining, documenting, and managing stakeholder needs and requirements to meet project objectives.
Data gathering takes part in the Elicit and Analyze Requirements process to obtain stakeholders’ requirements. It puts in use tools and techniques like benchmarking, brainstorming, focus groups, interviews, questionnaires, and surveys (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 40-41).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is managing a project for a startup that needs to quickly deliver a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) to capture an opportunity in the market.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Deliver a perfect product to ensure end users’ satisfaction.
opzioni.B: Opt for an iterative approach to allow early feedback.
opzioni.C: Eliminate change requests to deliver fast.
opzioni.D: Split deliverables into increments.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Delivering a perfect product entails adopting a predictive or iterative approach, which doesn’t serve the business objective of launching fast.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The concern of the startup is the fast delivery, not the product’s correctness or feedback.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Adopting a predictive approach won’t help the startup to launch fast, and eliminating change requests is not appropriate, as they could be necessary in some cases.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The project manager should opt for an incremental approach. Therefore, the project manager has to split deliverables into increments and ensure that the first increment has the necessary features to launch in the market and seize the opportunity (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 61-62).

domande.spiegazione: The project manager should opt for an incremental approach. Therefore, the project manager has to split deliverables into increments and ensure that the first increment has the necessary features to launch in the market and seize the opportunity (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 61-62).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading an Agile project through two-week sprints. One week into the first sprint, the project manager got a request from the product owner to immediately cancel the sprint.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Inform the product owner that the sprint is time-boxed and should continue till its predefined end date.
opzioni.B: Ask the team to just finish the work in progress and then terminate the sprint.
opzioni.C: Immediately cancel the sprint.
opzioni.D: Ask the product owner to provide a clear explanation of their decision in order to cancel the sprint.

domande.spiegazione: The product owner has the authority to cancel an ongoing sprint for any reason they think is valid. There is no sense in working on something that is not needed anymore. The project manager should terminate the sprint immediately, but they need to do their best to understand what caused this extreme decision: dissatisfaction, obsolete sprint backlog items, canceled project, etc.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is developing a software project using an iterative and incremental approach. During a retrospective meeting, and while the cross-functional team was discussing several potential improvements, the Scrum master was taking note of the associated action items.
What should the cross-functional team do next?

opzioni.A: Ask the product owner to approve action items.
opzioni.B: Ask the Scrum master to prioritize the action items.
opzioni.C: Prioritize the previous iteration’s unfinished user stories.
opzioni.D: Decide which action items should be prioritized for the next iteration.

domande.spiegazione:
The keyword in the question is “several”. Ideally, the team should identify a limited list of improvement action items and focus on addressing and prioritizing them, rather than considering too many improvements and eventually losing focus.
Option A: In a retrospective meeting, feedback concerning ways to improve work processes should be provided by the team, neither by the Scrum master nor the product owner.
Options B & C: The retrospective is a meeting intended to address lessons learned rather than plan for the next sprint or prioritize pending user stories.

domande.domanda:
A project manager had a major dispute with one of the project suppliers. The project manager claims that the vendor has failed to provide raw materials that conform to the agreed-upon quality requirements, while the vendor complains that payments were late, failing to meet contractual obligations.
What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Not waste more time and simply replace the vendor.
opzioni.B: Involve a third party for arbitration or mediation.
opzioni.C: Collaborate directly with the vendor to resolve the issue.
opzioni.D: Conduct a procurement audit.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Replacing the vendor should be the last resort once direct and assisted negotiations fail.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. If direct negotiation fails, then the project manager and the vendor can involve a third party for mediation and arbitration. Obviously, this will be more costly, risky, and time-consuming.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Working with the vendor to reach an agreement is a more direct problem-solving approach, and therefore should be the project manager’s first choice.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The procurement audit was most probably carried out before the issue occurred. Besides, it doesn’t address the vendor’s complaints about payment delays.

domande.spiegazione: Working with the vendor to reach an agreement is a more direct problem-solving approach, and therefore should be the project manager’s first choice.

domande.domanda:
During the project's planning, the project manager noticed that some stakeholders were unsupportive because they thought that they would lose their jobs due to the project.
What should the project manager do to overcome this problem?

opzioni.A: Disregard the project’s unsupportive stakeholders.
opzioni.B: Use the autocratic leadership style to be able to lead the project.
opzioni.C: Create an effective communications management plan and stakeholder engagement plan.
opzioni.D: Refuse to work on a project that might lead to job losses.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. As a project manager, you can’t disregard or ignore any stakeholders, regardless of their attitude towards your project. If anything, you should give more attention and put more effort into engaging unsupportive ones, in case they have a key role or big influence on your project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Autocratic leadership often leads to dissatisfaction and alienation among stakeholders, worsening resistance and creating further obstacles.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. By creating a comprehensive communication and engagement plan, the project manager can address stakeholders' concerns, provide clarity about the project's purpose, and highlight potential benefits, such as new roles or retraining opportunities. This builds trust and reduces resistance to change.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Refusing to manage the project doesn’t mean the project will be canceled; thus, it won’t change the fact that certain stakeholders will still lose their jobs. Moreover, since the project was chosen for execution, it’s intended to bring added value in spite of its downside for some involved stakeholders.

domande.spiegazione: By creating a comprehensive communication and engagement plan, the project manager can address stakeholders' concerns, provide clarity about the project's purpose, and highlight potential benefits, such as new roles or retraining opportunities. This builds trust and reduces resistance to change.
domande.nota: Dominio assente nell'esportazione Udemy: assegnato People (stakeholder engagement).

domande.domanda:
During an AI-powered financial system implementation, the project manager notices that the AI tool tends to recommend loan denials for applicants from certain zip codes. When discussing that with the project team, a team member suggested ignoring the bias to avoid delays in deployment.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Document the observation and proceed to stay on schedule.
opzioni.B: Raise the concern with senior management and the AI vendor to address potential bias.
opzioni.C: Limit the tool’s access to applicant zip codes.
opzioni.D: Continue using the tool while planning a future update to address fairness.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Proceeding despite known ethical risks violates the value of responsibility. Documenting bias doesn’t absolve the PM from taking corrective action.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. Raising the concern with senior management and the AI vendor to address potential bias reflects fairness and honesty. Bias in AI decision-making can result in unethical outcomes like discrimination (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 239 & 243). The PM must act to resolve the issue, ensuring the AI tool aligns with responsible use and social impact expectations.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Quietly altering the data input without informing stakeholders reflects a lack of transparency. This could also reduce the AI model’s accuracy without full stakeholder understanding or buy-in.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Delaying resolution of a known bias problem violates respect for affected stakeholders. Postponing ethical action for convenience reflects poor judgment in professional conduct.

domande.spiegazione: Raising the concern with senior management and the AI vendor to address potential bias reflects fairness and honesty. Bias in AI decision-making can result in unethical outcomes like discrimination (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 239 & 243). The PM must act to resolve the issue, ensuring the AI tool aligns with responsible use and social impact expectations.

domande.domanda: In which activity do the product owner and the cross-functional team discuss possible approaches to implement user stories, as well as provide some initial size estimations?

opzioni.A: Brainstorming
opzioni.B: Story mapping
opzioni.C: Backlog refinement
opzioni.D: Iteration planning

domande.spiegazione: Backlog refinement provides a chance for the product owner, along with the team, to discuss and address anything associated with the stories’ requirements. This can involve discussing requirements, potential approaches, and even some estimations in order to eventually build a clear idea of how to approach stories.

domande.domanda:
During the iteration review, the project team demonstrated new features to the Product Owner. The product owner was resting his hands on the table with a relaxed and open posture, while occasionally fiddling with his pen or coffee mug without looking directly at the speaker.
What kind of communication is the product owner using? (Select two)

opzioni.A: Paralingual communication
opzioni.B: Active listening
opzioni.C: Implicit message
opzioni.D: Non-verbal communication

domande.spiegazione:
Non-verbal communication is used to convey implicit messages. It includes gestures, facial expressions, and paralinguistics such as voice tone or volume, body language, personal space, eye contact, touch, and appearance. These non-verbal signals can provide additional information and meaning to verbal communication (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 184).
Option A: Paralingual communication (such as the use of voice tone, volume, pitch, intonation, etc.) is non-verbal, but it’s not the right answer because the product owner didn’t communicate any vocal messages.
Option B: The scenario doesn’t describe active listening either, since the product owner is not interacting or paying attention to the demonstration.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a manufacturing project to create a new gaming console. While testing the product, the project team discovers that one of the controller buttons is not functioning properly. To replace the button, a change request was submitted and approved.
This change request represents:

opzioni.A: Corrective action
opzioni.B: Preventive action
opzioni.C: Defect repair
opzioni.D: Gold plating

domande.spiegazione:
Change requests that get approved involve: a defect repair, a corrective or preventive action, or an update (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 30). The situation implies that some of the buttons on the wireless controller developed by the project team are not functioning as required. This is considered a defect repair since the team has taken immediate action to correct the defective product components due to their non-conformance with requirements.
Options A & B: This is neither a preventive nor a corrective action since it’s not tackling an inconsistency with the agreed-upon project baseline.
Option D: It’s not a case of gold plating either, as changing non-functioning buttons was carried on to meet the product’s initial specifications, not to enhance it or satisfy the customer.

domande.domanda:
Since the project stakeholders' needs were quite vague and imprecise, the project manager was worried about the occurrence of multiple change requests as well as excessive rework during the execution phase.
What can the project manager do in this case?

opzioni.A: Create the project scope and break it down into work packages during the project planning phase.
opzioni.B: Opt for an iterative and incremental approach for the project execution.
opzioni.C: Set up a firm change control system that will only approve critical changes to be implemented.
opzioni.D: Create an activity list using the currently known information and opt for a Kanban board to convert those activities into tasks.

domande.spiegazione:
The requirements, in this case, were vague due to the project’s nature. Thus, they can only be expressed at a high, broad level. This can present a challenge when collecting requirements and, more importantly, when decomposing work during the project planning phase. Iterative and incremental approaches are quite suitable for projects with a high level of uncertainty, as they allow the scope to develop along the course of the project. In order to ensure that the product will be aligned with stakeholders’ requirements, the incremental approach permits the delivery and demonstration of partial increments, thus allowing for continuous feedback (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 63).
Options A, C, D: All of the other suggested actions are not suitable for a project with ambiguous requirements and a high degree of uncertainty.

domande.domanda:
A project manager decided to issue a Request For Proposal (RFP) to acquire new equipment and assigned the associated tasks to their team as shown in the following RACI chart:
When the RFP was released, the project manager received a lot of complaints from different suppliers claiming that the procurement document was not clear, as it included some contradictory requirements.
Who should the project manager refer to in order to address this issue? [Dati ricostruiti dalla spiegazione: nella RACI per la stesura della RFP Stefania è Accountable e Michelle è Responsible]
⚠️ Nell'esportazione Udemy manca l'immagine (grafico/tabella) a cui fa riferimento la domanda.

opzioni.A: Stefania
opzioni.B: Michelle
opzioni.C: Tushar
opzioni.D: Samarth

domande.spiegazione:
According to the RACI chart, Stefania is accountable for the activity of writing the RFP. Therefore, the project manager needs to talk to Stefania in order to investigate the issue (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 194-195).
Option B: Michelle is the one responsible for writing the RFP, but she should not be held accountable if something goes wrong, as this situation implies.

domande.domanda:
During sprint planning, the cross-functional team realized that they had selected more items than they could realistically complete during a sprint.
What should the Scrum master do?

opzioni.A: Allocate more resources to the team.
opzioni.B: Discuss the issue in the next sprint retrospective.
opzioni.C: Request from the team to make more effort to finish the selected tasks.
opzioni.D: Inform the product owner that some items should be removed from the sprint.

domande.spiegazione: Since the Sprint hasn’t yet started, the cross-functional team can still make changes to the Sprint Backlog items. During sprint planning, if the team realizes that they might not be able to accomplish the selected items, they can decide to remove some of them in consensus with the Product Owner, since they’re the only person in charge of approving the sprint backlog items.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading the construction of a data center. The project management plan states that the air conditioning system should be set up according to a thorough study carried out by a specialized company. However, after getting their quote, the sponsor refused to spend such a high price even though it was within the project budget.
What should the project manager do first to resolve this issue?

opzioni.A: Ask the sponsor to issue a change request involving their decision not to hire the company.
