domande.domanda:
A project manager for a high-rise construction project is using an AI scheduling tool that prioritizes tasks based on historical data. The tool consistently assigns shorter timelines to local contractors and longer buffers to international teams, despite similar past performance. Team morale is declining due to perceived unfairness.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Manually override the tool’s schedules to equalize timelines.
opzioni.B: Audit the training data for regional bias and recalibrate the algorithm.
opzioni.C: Stop using the tool and revert to spreadsheets to avoid conflict.
opzioni.D: Request that the PMO take over all scheduling decisions to remove subjectivity.

domande.spiegazione:
The project manager must address the bias while preserving the tool’s benefits. Auditing the data and recalibrating aligns with PMBOK’s directive that “the project team should ensure the accuracy of data and the neutrality of outputs" (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 32).
Options A, C, D: Overriding schedules ignores the root cause of the issue. Abandoning the tool wastes resources, and delegating all scheduling decisions to the PMO avoids the team’s responsibility to govern technology.

domande.domanda:
During a planning session, a project management team determined that they needed to purchase new IT equipment in November. The project manager thought it would be a good idea to take advantage of Black Friday’s discounts since it takes place in the last week of November.
What should the project team do to not miss this opportunity?

opzioni.A: Exploit the opportunity
opzioni.B: Share the opportunity
opzioni.C: Enhance the opportunity
opzioni.D: Accept the opportunity

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The project team should exploit this opportunity by taking specific actions and preparing the required conditions to take advantage of the opportunity (PMBOK 8th edition, page 157). For example, before Black Friday, the project team can prepare a list of sellers, contact them to verify if they’re planning to have any Black Friday discounts, subscribe to their newsletters to be notified of any opportunities, etc.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The project team can exploit this opportunity without having to share it with a third party.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. While exploiting the opportunity consists of acting to ensure that it occurs, enhancing it means acting to increase the probability of its occurrence or impact. For instance, the project team can enhance the opportunity by purchasing the needed IT equipment during the last week of November. However, this does not ensure that they’ll find discounts on the equipment they want to purchase, thus they could miss the opportunity.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Accepting the opportunity without taking any action means that the team can end up buying the equipment at any time during November, and they can miss the opportunity, i.e., the Black Friday discounts.

domande.spiegazione: The project team should exploit this opportunity by taking specific actions and preparing the required conditions to take advantage of the opportunity (PMBOK 8th edition, page 157). For example, before Black Friday, the project team can prepare a list of sellers, contact them to verify if they’re planning to have any Black Friday discounts, subscribe to their newsletters to be notified of any opportunities, etc.

domande.domanda:
An agile team is working on developing an innovative digital product. The product owner added a user story in the product backlog and noted that it should be implemented in the next release. During a refinement session with the product owner, the development team stated that they are not sure about the user story implementation since it requires particular inputs from the current release.
What should the development team do next?

opzioni.A: Further study the different implementation scenarios of the user story.
opzioni.B: Prioritize the user story since it involves a high level of ambiguity and risk.
opzioni.C: Stop spending more time trying to figure out how to implement the user story until they collect more information.
opzioni.D: Give the user story a final estimation based on the current understanding and available information.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. In this case, since determining how to implement the concerned user story requires inputs from the current release, the development team should wait until they are able to know more about these inputs.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The product owner is the one responsible for prioritizing work. Needless to say, prioritizing user stories should be based on values in addition to their ambiguity or risk.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The agile approach follows Lean principles. Among these principles is “deciding as late as possible”; when it’s difficult to make a decision or plan an activity, you should delay it or postpone it until you have enough information or data for you to be able to make an educated decision. This practice is known as the last responsible moment concept.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Final estimates are usually assigned during sprint planning or whenever the user story implementation is clearly decided upon.

domande.spiegazione: The agile approach follows Lean principles. Among these principles is “deciding as late as possible”; when it’s difficult to make a decision or plan an activity, you should delay it or postpone it until you have enough information or data for you to be able to make an educated decision. This practice is known as the last responsible moment concept.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a project with remote team members in different geographical areas. During a virtual fortnightly retrospective meeting, the project manager finds out that some members either forgot, missed, or did not fully understand what was discussed in the previous meeting.
What should the project manager do? (Select two)

opzioni.A: Ask all team members to try to speak English with an American accent.
opzioni.B: Create a new group norm requiring meeting attendees to raise their hands when they don’t understand something.
opzioni.C: Record meeting sessions and send the recordings to everyone involved.
opzioni.D: Change the meeting frequency to weekly rather than fortnightly so that team members do not forget what has been discussed.

domande.spiegazione:
To solve the issue, the project manager can create a group norm, inciting attendees to raise their hands when they have questions. They can also record meeting sessions and send recordings to all attendees. Raising hands is practical in physical meetings as well as in video conferences. If a team member raises their hand to ask a question and still doesn’t understand a particular point, or if they missed part of the discussion, they can refer back to the recording.
Option A: The project manager cannot force team members to speak with an American accent. If someone has an unclear accent, then the project manager could offer to provide them with training, if the team member is willing, in order to improve their accent.
Option D: The meeting frequency should not be changed just because participants tend to forget meeting outputs. Meeting minutes and recordings are effective tools to address such an issue.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a software project. A team member is in charge of developing the User Interface (UI). Even though this member is doing a great job, their work pace is way slower than expected, which can cause the whole project to miss its deadline.
What should the project manager do first in this situation?

opzioni.A: Delegate some of the team member’s tasks to other team members
opzioni.B: Remove the team member from the project
opzioni.C: Find out the cause of the team member’s slow work pace
opzioni.D: Give the concerned team member other non-critical tasks

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. If it turns out that the concerned team member is overallocated, it might be better to assign some of their work to other members.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Regardless of their slow work pace, the concerned team member is doing a great job. Therefore, removing them from the project can have a negative impact on the quality of the deliverables.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. Before taking any corrective measures, the project manager should determine the underlying cause of the problem.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Assigning non-critical tasks to the team member can have a bad impact on their motivation, plus it does not resolve the main problem, i.e., their slow work pace.

domande.spiegazione: Before taking any corrective measures, the project manager should determine the underlying cause of the problem.

domande.domanda:
Since switching to the agile approach, a project manager has been encouraging their team to be self-organizing by allowing them to decide how to execute their assigned work.
What is the main aspect of a self-organizing team?

opzioni.A: It gives more responsibility to the project manager
opzioni.B: It gives more responsibility to the Agile team
opzioni.C: It allows the team to deliver a working product without external dependencies
opzioni.D: It gives team members higher visibility of the product

domande.spiegazione:
Unlike conventional teams, self-organizing teams do not wait for their supervisors to assign them tasks. Instead, they determine which tasks must be accomplished, prioritize those tasks, and handle their schedules and deadlines on their own. Self-organizing teams tend to have a greater sense of ownership, engagement, and responsibility.
Option C: A Cross-functional team consists of team members with all the needed skills to produce a working product without external dependencies.
Option D: Higher visibility of the product could only be developed by the product owner through backlog refinement.

domande.domanda:
A project manager works for an organization that uses extrinsic motivators to improve team morale and productivity.
What incentives should the project manager offer the team in order to comply with the company’s policy? (Select three)

opzioni.A: Create an “Employee of the Month” award
opzioni.B: Offer a $10,000 bonus for the most performant team members
opzioni.C: Allow team members to work on tasks they enjoy
opzioni.D: Praise team members for their hard work

domande.spiegazione:
Extrinsic motivation is described as actions motivated by external factors such as grades, popularity, money, and praise. This form of motivation arises from external factors, as opposed to intrinsic motivation, which comes from within the person (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 182).
Option C: Allowing each team member to work on things that they genuinely love to do presents a form of intrinsic motivation.

domande.domanda:
Now that the project is nearly finished, a key stakeholder asked the project manager about the project deliverables approval process. The project manager replied that he was confident that the customer would be satisfied with the result.
What can ensure the satisfaction of the project’s customer?

opzioni.A: The project’s low running costs.
opzioni.B: How good the project manager’s relationship is with the project’s end-users and stakeholders.
opzioni.C: The efficiency of the warranty service.
opzioni.D: Delivering value and conforming to project requirements.

domande.spiegazione: It’s not enough to complete a project on time and under budget. You need to deliver value by creating a suitable product for your stakeholders’ needs. Customer satisfaction is about making sure that the people who are paying for the end product are happy with what they ultimately get. Conformance to requirements and usability of deliverables are the basis of customer satisfaction, as they allow you to measure how well your product meets expectations.

domande.domanda:
4 months into project execution, the project manager noticed that the performance of some of the team members was deteriorating, while others continued to perform well.
What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Assign additional responsibilities to high-performing team members to offset the impact of underperformance.
opzioni.B: Conduct a private discussion with each underperforming team member to encourage improvement.
opzioni.C: Review workload distribution before taking any action.
opzioni.D: Investigate the root causes of performance issues and collect structured feedback.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Assigning additional responsibilities to high-performing team members risks overloading top performers, can create resentment, further harming team morale, and doesn’t address or resolve the performance issue.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Conducting a private discussion with each underperforming team member to encourage improvement, without seeking feedback or investigating the problem, doesn’t address the issue or its related causes.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Reviewing workload distribution as the first and only initial action is insufficient; it assumes that the root cause of the performance issue is an imbalanced workload, ignoring other equally plausible causes (skill gaps, lack of clarity, motivational issues, resource blockers, etc.).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. The project manager’s objective should be to understand why a once competent team member is now struggling. They should first recognize the symptoms, reach out to the underperforming team members, talk to them to try to find out the cause, offer help, monitor and measure progress, and be sure to share their feedback.

domande.spiegazione: The project manager’s objective should be to understand why a once competent team member is now struggling. They should first recognize the symptoms, reach out to the underperforming team members, talk to them to try to find out the cause, offer help, monitor and measure progress, and be sure to share their feedback.

domande.domanda:
A project manager presented a stadium construction project that he believes will benefit the community tremendously. Despite the mayor's agreement to carry out the project, the project manager encountered strong resistance from various stakeholders from the beginning.
What should the project manager do to resolve this problem?

opzioni.A: Create a Responsibility Assignment Matrix (RAM) to indicate which stakeholder is responsible for what aspects of the project and who needs to be consulted or informed.
opzioni.B: Create an organizational diagram to assign each stakeholder to the appropriate project role, allowing or disallowing certain lines of communication.
opzioni.C: Schedule a meeting with the concerned stakeholders to thoroughly explain the project, discuss and establish ground rules, ensure their involvement, and identify any personal or organizational issues that might surface later on.
opzioni.D: Avoid contacting these stakeholders at the start of the project and instead create a “fait accompli” to pressure them to support the project due to a lack of alternatives.

domande.spiegazione: The project manager should schedule a meeting with the concerned stakeholders to present the project, discuss and establish ground rules, ensure their involvement, and identify any personal or organizational issues. The project manager can overcome stakeholder resistance by simply listening to their concerns. The purpose is to see things from their perspective. The project manager should understand what drives and motivates the stakeholder in order to establish common ground and understand the reason behind such resistance.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is assigned to lead a new public transportation project. Early in the project, local residents raised concerns about increased noise and traffic congestion during construction. These concerns were documented but not formally addressed in the risk register. These concerns are now causing delays due to community protests.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Nothing, since the project has already begun.
opzioni.B: Offer financial compensation to affected residents.
opzioni.C: Ask the city council to handle the protests since they did not foresee this backlash.
opzioni.D: Update the risk register to develop mitigation strategies.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Ignoring community concerns can escalate tensions and result in legal or reputational damage. Stakeholder expectations must be actively managed throughout the project lifecycle.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Offering compensation without addressing the root cause may temporarily pacify residents, but it does not resolve the issue. A structured risk response is more effective and sustainable.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Shifting blame undermines the trust of a key stakeholder (the city council). The project manager should act with integrity and accountability.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Updating the risk register allows the project team to analyze the potential impact of the community concerns and create mitigation plans, such as adjusting construction hours or enhancing communication. This aligns with best practices in stakeholder and risk management.

domande.spiegazione: Updating the risk register allows the project team to analyze the potential impact of the community concerns and create mitigation plans, such as adjusting construction hours or enhancing communication. This aligns with best practices in stakeholder and risk management.

domande.domanda:
During the sprint review, the product owner informs the Scrum team that the meeting is being recorded in order to send it to a key stakeholder. A day later, the stakeholder contacted the product owner to express their disappointment with the product, claiming that it was nothing like what they had in mind.
What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Facilitate a meeting between the product owner and the concerned stakeholder.
opzioni.B: Meet the stakeholder to review the product backlog items.
opzioni.C: Ask the development team to have more frequent backlog refinement sessions with the product owner.
opzioni.D: Ask the development team to collaborate with the key stakeholder.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. Since the product doesn’t meet the expectations of the key stakeholder, there is no alignment between the product owner and the stakeholder. The product owner is responsible for gathering and prioritizing requirements. The stakeholder’s feedback indicates that the product owner didn’t involve them enough in the process. As an agile project manager or Scrum master, you can help the product owner, who is the stakeholder representative, while also protecting your team from dealing with such issues.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. In Scrum, it’s the product owner’s responsibility to review the product backlog items.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The project manager should address the issue at hand. The frequency of the backlog refinement is not related to the dissatisfaction of the key stakeholder.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The development team should collaborate with the product owner, who in turn should review the product backlog items with the key stakeholder, being their point of contact in the project.

domande.spiegazione: Since the product doesn’t meet the expectations of the key stakeholder, there is no alignment between the product owner and the stakeholder. The product owner is responsible for gathering and prioritizing requirements. The stakeholder’s feedback indicates that the product owner didn’t involve them enough in the process. As an agile project manager or Scrum master, you can help the product owner, who is the stakeholder representative, while also protecting your team from dealing with such issues.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading an adaptive project using an online project management system that displays the real-time progress of the iterations and the overall project through different charts. However, a key stakeholder prefers to receive an email with the weekly status report instead.
What should the project manager do? (Select two)

opzioni.A: Add a small recurring task of “1” story point in the product backlog to send the weekly report.
opzioni.B: Take this in charge in order to let the team focus on achieving deliverables.
opzioni.C: Check if there is a way to automatically send the weekly report through the project management system.
opzioni.D: Ignore the stakeholder request since they have access to the online system and therefore can easily check the project status.

domande.spiegazione: Nessuna spiegazione presente nell'esportazione Udemy.

domande.domanda:
A project manager keeps receiving negative feedback concerning one of the project suppliers. The conflicts between the project team and the supplier’s team are getting worse recently and are starting to have a negative impact on the project.
What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Send an email to the supplier’s team manager explaining the alarming situation.
opzioni.B: Meet with the supplier’s team manager to discuss the issue.
opzioni.C: Call the supplier’s team manager and urge them to commit to the procurement agreement.
opzioni.D: Proceed with Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR).

domande.spiegazione:
When you want to resolve a conflict, a face-to-face meeting is always the best first step. Hence, the project manager should meet with the manager of the supplier’s team to discuss the issue and try to find a solution.
Options A & C: Other communication methods, such as sending an email or having a phone call, are less effective than an in-person meeting.
Option D: If direct negotiation fails, then the project manager should proceed with Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR), such as mediation or arbitration.

domande.domanda:
During the planning of a call center project, a stakeholder mentioned that since the internet cable (DSL) used can be slow, it should be considered a high risk to the project. However, based on their previous projects, the project manager thinks that the cable internet would work just fine for the project. Another stakeholder intervenes to explain that the internet cable speed and reliability vary depending on the geographical location.
What should the project manager do first?

opzioni.A: Analyze and prioritize the risk by using a probability and impact matrix.
opzioni.B: Set a contingency reserve to install fiber Internet cables if the threat occurs.
opzioni.C: Perform a qualitative risk analysis by developing a risk mitigation plan.
opzioni.D: Perform a quantitative risk analysis to determine the risk exposure.

domande.spiegazione:
The project manager should first perform a qualitative risk analysis to assess risk occurrence, probability, and impact. After that, they should further analyze the prioritized risks using quantitative risk analysis (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 96). With this type of risk analysis, the project manager will be able to determine the risk exposure level, develop a risk mitigation plan, or define a contingency reserve.
Option B: Setting a contingency reserve is a risk response that should be done after conducting qualitative and quantitative analysis.
Option C: Qualitative risk analysis is performed by using a probability and impact matrix, not by developing a risk mitigation plan.

domande.domanda:
A project manager receives a document from the customer containing the new project’s requirements. When going through the document, the project manager finds it difficult to understand certain requirements, outputs, and, most importantly, the project’s ultimate goal.
What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Ask the customer for clarification
opzioni.B: Reject the new project as it involves a lot of ambiguity
opzioni.C: Start planning the first iteration
opzioni.D: Acquire a team to help analyze the project requirements

domande.spiegazione:
In case of ambiguity, the project manager should first ask for clarifications from the customer before making any further decisions. This helps align expectations and avoids costly misunderstandings later in the project.
Option A: Rejecting the project outright without attempting to resolve the ambiguity is unprofessional and may damage the relationship with the client. Most ambiguities can be clarified through effective communication.
Options C & D: It’s not appropriate to start planning project work or acquire a team without first creating a clear vision of what the project consists of.

domande.domanda:
A fintech project manager discovers that their AI-driven testing tool was trained on a third-party dataset with unclear security protocols. The tool is critical for meeting regulatory deadlines, but it may expose sensitive client data.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Isolate the tool on a secure server and continue using it to avoid delays.
opzioni.B: Halt the tool’s use and report the risk to the IT department for a security assessment.
opzioni.C: Limit the tool’s access to non-sensitive test cases only.
opzioni.D: Document the risk and proceed to meet deadlines.

domande.spiegazione:
It’s the team’s responsibility to align with the IT department to safeguard project information. Therefore, the project manager should halt the tool’s use and report the risk to the IT department for a security assessment; immediate risk escalation is the only option that prioritizes security (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 239).
Options A, C, D: Isolating the tool on a secure server and continuing to use it to avoid delays, using it only for non-sensitive test cases, or documenting the risk and proceeding still leaves client data at risk, ignoring the ethical duty to protect stakeholders.

domande.domanda:
Two team members discuss an issue concerning server configuration. When the first member asks why this issue keeps happening, the second member says that server parameters are confusing, making it difficult for him to handle its configuration. The first team member suggests that he should be consulted the next few times the server is being configured, to which the second team member agrees, and the problem is solved.
Which conflict resolution technique is being used in this situation?

opzioni.A: Collaborating
opzioni.B: Directing
opzioni.C: Norming
opzioni.D: Reconciling

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. The two team members used collaboration as a conflict resolution technique, which is also known as problem-solving. This technique is used when multiple viewpoints and insights from differing perspectives are incorporated. This technique requires a cooperative attitude and open dialogue that typically leads to consensus and commitment (PMBOK 8th edition, page 157).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. The situation is not “Directing” since the scenario did not involve pushing one’s viewpoint at the expense of others.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Norming is not a conflict-resolution technique; it is a team development stage according to the Tuckman Ladder model.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The situation is not “Reconciling” either, since it does not involve searching for solutions that bring some degree of satisfaction to all parties in order to temporarily or partially resolve the conflict.

domande.spiegazione: The two team members used collaboration as a conflict resolution technique, which is also known as problem-solving. This technique is used when multiple viewpoints and insights from differing perspectives are incorporated. This technique requires a cooperative attitude and open dialogue that typically leads to consensus and commitment (PMBOK 8th edition, page 157).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is about to subcontract the installation of the building's heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) system. The project manager is currently looking into the payment structures and terms that will be used throughout the life of the contract.
When should the project manager choose a Time & Material contract instead of a Fixed Price contract? (Select two)

opzioni.A: When the goal is to limit cost risks
opzioni.B: When the scope is barely defined
opzioni.C: When the work duration is not determined
opzioni.D: When the scope is precisely defined
opzioni.E: When the subcontractor requests its usage

domande.spiegazione:
A Time & Material (T&M) contract is an agreement in which the contractor is paid based on the actual labor cost (in hourly rates – man-hour), in addition to any materials and equipment usage. This contract type is used when there is no firm scope, or the work duration is not determined (i.e., ongoing development of the product) (PMBOK 8th edition, page 251).
Option A: In a Fixed Price contract, the subcontractor will either make a profit if they can install HVAC for less than the lump sum value, or they will lose money if they cannot install HVAC for the predetermined value. This transfers a significant amount of risk to the subcontractor.
Option D: A lump sum contract, Fixed Price, is used when the scope is clear.
Option E: The project manager has to choose the payment structure that suits the project’s needs, regardless of what the subcontractor wants.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is assigned to manage a software project. During execution, the project manager discovered that one of the contracted software development teams was not meeting the specified performance requirements. The code quality is below standard, resulting in frequent system crashes and performance bottlenecks during user testing. This non-conformance compromises the functionality and usability of the software.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Initiate a formal review process with the software development team to assess the performance issues and implement a corrective action plan to address and improve code quality.
opzioni.B: Consider initiating legal action, such as litigation or arbitration, to enforce compliance with performance requirements and seek compensation for damages incurred.
opzioni.C: Focus on prioritizing essential functionalities and features that can be developed or revised by other contracted or in-house development teams to ensure project success.
opzioni.D: Conduct an independent assessment of the non-conforming contractor's work to improve code quality and performance.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. A structured review process and collaborative development of a corrective action plan promote proactive issue resolution, which is the right course of action in this situation.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. While legal recourse is an option in extreme cases, it should be considered as a last resort after exhausting all other options.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Prioritizing essential functionalities and features that can be developed or revised by other contracted or in-house development teams does not address the underlying issues, nor does it ensure the delivery of a successful project.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. While seeking expert advice through conducting an independent assessment can be valuable, it should be complemented by collaboration and involvement of the software development team to ensure ownership and alignment with project objectives.

domande.spiegazione: A structured review process and collaborative development of a corrective action plan promote proactive issue resolution, which is the right course of action in this situation.

domande.domanda:
A project manager attended a meeting to finalize a procurement that was still in the negotiation stage. However, the project manager noticed that discussions tend to drift to various irrelevant topics, with attendees occasionally going back to the meeting’s main topic.
What is this meeting missing? (Select two)

opzioni.A: Minutes
opzioni.B: An agenda
opzioni.C: An objective
opzioni.D: A facilitator

domande.spiegazione:
The meeting probably does not have either a clear agenda or a facilitator. An agenda organizes and structures a meeting’s discussions, while a facilitator ensures that the agenda is being followed and respected.
Option A: Minutes of Meeting, aka MoM, is a summary of what happened during a meeting. MoM serve as a written record for future reference, thus it cannot be what caused this meeting to be chaotic.
Option C: The meeting already has an objective; concluding a procurement in the negotiation phase. But, since no one is assigned to facilitate the meeting, it’s probable that the objective was not appropriately communicated to all attendees in the first place, resulting in the described chaos.

domande.domanda:
Match each communication method with its corresponding advantages in the table below: [Dati ricostruiti dalla spiegazione: vantaggi in tabella, nell'ordine: aumenta flessibilità e riduce pressione; crea connessioni e più coinvolgimento; riduce ambiguità e assicura impegno; fa risparmiare costi e limita interruzioni]
⚠️ Nell'esportazione Udemy manca l'immagine (grafico/tabella) a cui fa riferimento la domanda.

opzioni.A: Asynchronous, virtual, written, face-to-face
opzioni.B: Asynchronous, face-to-face, written, virtual
opzioni.C: Written, virtual, face-to-face, asynchronous
opzioni.D: Face-to-face, asynchronous, written, virtual

domande.spiegazione:
Asynchronous communication: Increases flexibility and reduces pressure
Face-to-face communication: Builds connections and leads to more engagement
Written communication: Decreases ambiguity and ensures commitment
Virtual communication: Saves costs and limits interruptions
domande.motivo_incertezza: immagine della domanda non presente nell'esportazione

domande.domanda:
A project manager often encourages the project team to use a checklist of the key elements of active listening before any important meeting with stakeholders.
Which of the following are regarded as elements of active listening? (Select three)

opzioni.A: Making eye contact
opzioni.B: Paraphrasing
opzioni.C: Negotiation
opzioni.D: Interpreting information
opzioni.E: Interrupting when appropriate

domande.spiegazione:
Active listening is a skill that can be acquired and developed through practice. Instead of passively receiving the speaker’s message, active listening entails paying close attention to what is being said, asking questions to get a clear understanding of the situation, maintaining comfortable eye contact, remaining open-minded about others’ opinions, employing paraphrasing skills and feedback, and keeping an eye on non-verbal signs such as the body language and facial expressions of the speaker.
Option C: Negotiation involves reaching an agreement through discussion and compromise, while active listening focuses on fully understanding and acknowledging the other person's perspective without immediate judgment or response.
Option E: Active listening involves allowing others to completely express their ideas without interrupting them.

domande.domanda:
Upon the client’s request, a project manager of an e-commerce website development project agreed to extend the scope while committing to the same delivery date. In order to achieve that, the project team must work 24/7.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Start a night shift for the collocated team members
opzioni.B: Hire virtual teams that work in different time zones and schedules
opzioni.C: Fast-track the project
opzioni.D: Use the resource leveling technique

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The current team is not able to finish the work by the determined delivery date. Making them work at night will not change anything, as it won’t have an impact on the pace of work.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The project manager can crash the project by hiring a virtual team that works in different time zones and on different days of the week (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 196-197). Hiring resources from different geographical zones allows the project to operate 24/7 without overworking the team. Since the project involves creating an e-commerce website, having virtual teams on the project is functional and practical. Constructing or manufacturing projects, on the other hand, can’t take advantage of hiring a virtual team. However, they can opt for night shifts as a workable alternative.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Fast Tracking is a schedule compression technique that consists of concurrently completing tasks that would normally be completed sequentially. According to the scenario, the project manager needs to crash the project since the workload has increased significantly to the point that the project team has to work 24/7 to complete it.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The resource leveling technique implies distributing workload based on resource’ constraints. This technique is typically used in the schedule planning phase of a predictive project.

domande.spiegazione: The project manager can crash the project by hiring a virtual team that works in different time zones and on different days of the week (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 196-197). Hiring resources from different geographical zones allows the project to operate 24/7 without overworking the team. Since the project involves creating an e-commerce website, having virtual teams on the project is functional and practical. Constructing or manufacturing projects, on the other hand, can’t take advantage of hiring a virtual team. However, they can opt for night shifts as a workable alternative.

domande.domanda:
An agile coach was invited to assist an organization in its transition to the Scrum framework. After examining the current situation, the agile coach finds out that the cross-functional team lacks a Single Point Of Contact (SPOC) to refer to in case they have any questions about the product.
Which of the following roles is missing in this situation?

opzioni.A: Scrum Master
opzioni.B: Sponsor
opzioni.C: Product Owner
opzioni.D: Project Manager

domande.spiegazione: The Product Owner, also known as the "voice of the customer," is the one in charge of ensuring that the cross-functional team creates value. The Product Owner ensures that the product specifications are clearly communicated to the team through the definition of Acceptance Criteria and ensuring that those criteria are met and satisfied. A Scrum team comprises three main roles: cross-functional team members, product owner, and team facilitator. The latter is also known as the project manager, Scrum master, team lead, or team coach (Agile Practice Guide, pages 40-41).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is managing a project using a hybrid approach. After one week of the first iteration, the customer informed the project manager that they were dissatisfied with the deliverables.
What should the project manager do next?

opzioni.A: Ask the customer to submit a change request so that their dissatisfaction can be addressed.
opzioni.B: Use soft skills to convince the customer that the deliverables conform to project specifications.
opzioni.C: Investigate the cause of dissatisfaction and verify the deliverables.
opzioni.D: Implement adjustments and improvements in the next iteration.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Since the project is hybrid, the project manager may need to ask the customer to submit a change request if out-of-scope work is requested.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. If the project manager realizes that it’s just a misunderstanding or the customer is missing some details regarding the project deliverables, then the project manager can simply use their soft skills to explain and convince them that the deliverables are good.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Correct. The first thing the project manager should do is listen to the customer, take note of the reasons behind their dissatisfaction, and verify the deliverables. Once this is done, the project manager will be equipped with all of the needed information to make the best decision.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. If the deliverables do not meet specifications or require improvement, then the project manager should plan to implement changes in the upcoming iterations according to the priorities set by the customer.

domande.spiegazione: The first thing the project manager should do is listen to the customer, take note of the reasons behind their dissatisfaction, and verify the deliverables. Once this is done, the project manager will be equipped with all of the needed information to make the best decision.

domande.domanda:
The project team includes the following members:
Member A: is very excited about the project
Member B: sometimes exceeds expectations
Member C: often spends additional time working on the project
Member D: consistently achieves the project's requirements
Who is the most valuable resource to the project?

opzioni.A: Member A
opzioni.B: Member B
opzioni.C: Member C
opzioni.D: Member D

domande.spiegazione:
Team member D is the best project resource since they regularly meet project requirements.
Option A, B, C: Even if a team member is excited about the project (Member A), occasionally exceeding expectations (Member B), or spending additional time working on the project (Member C), it doesn't mean that these team members can meet the project criteria.

domande.domanda:
At the end of the iteration, a team member informs the project manager that she wasn’t able to finish one of her assigned tasks due to an issue with her laptop.
What should the project manager do in order to prevent such a situation from occurring in the future?

opzioni.A: Discuss the issue during the demonstration session
opzioni.B: Address the issue during the following iteration planning meeting
opzioni.C: Handle the issue during the next daily standup meeting
opzioni.D: Discuss the issue during the retrospective meeting

domande.spiegazione: An Agile retrospective meeting takes place frequently throughout the project, or at least at the end of each iteration, during which the team discusses what happened during the iteration and determines improvement areas for future iterations. The retrospective allows issues to be identified and discussed along with ideas for improvements. Retrospectives are a primary tool for managing project knowledge and developing the team through discussing what went well and what needs to be improved (PMBOK 8th edition, page 194).

domande.domanda:
During the planning phase, and in order to acquire physical resources, the project manager of a high-tech project received many proposals from qualified suppliers with whom they had worked in previous projects, along with proposals from other suppliers.
To compare the different suppliers and make the best choice, which of the following tools or techniques should the project manager use?

opzioni.A: Procurement performance review
opzioni.B: Selection criteria
opzioni.C: Procurement audit
opzioni.D: Make or buy analysis

domande.spiegazione:
It's essential for both the project manager and the project team to create selection criteria to rate and score proposals from the suppliers (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 249-250). In the case of a bid or quote, the price offered by the seller represents the main evaluation criterion. In other cases involving proposals, the evaluation criteria can include various aspects such as the seller’s experience, references, certifications, etc.
Option D: In this scenario, the project manager has received proposals, so a make-or-buy analysis should have already been carried out at this point.
Option C & A: An audit or a performance review should take place at a later stage to verify that all procurement processes were respected and that the purchased items conform to requirements.

domande.domanda:
A nonprofit installing water filters in rural areas has distributed 40% of the units when they learn that a UN initiative offers free filters for nonprofits that provide hygiene training to villages. Their current project lacks training components.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Design a training program to partner with the UN and extend the project.
opzioni.B: Continue the original plan to avoid delays in filter distribution.
opzioni.C: Skip joining the initiative for now to avoid rework.
opzioni.D: Refer the UN to another NGO to maintain project independence.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. By designing a training program to partner with the UN and extend the project, the project manager can seize the opportunity and maximize the impact of the project (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 49). Project managers should adapt when external changes can create a greater impact for stakeholders. By adding a training program, the nonprofit not only gains access to free filters (reducing costs and extending reach) but also improves sustainability through hygiene education, directly supporting the project’s mission to improve community health.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Skipping the initiative due to rework means missing the opportunity to deliver greater long-term value and benefit to the project's stakeholders.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Partial implementation creates inequitable solutions among villages.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Maintaining project independence rejects the potential for greater impact and limits resources and broader reach.

domande.spiegazione: By designing a training program to partner with the UN and extend the project, the project manager can seize the opportunity and maximize the impact of the project (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 49). Project managers should adapt when external changes can create a greater impact for stakeholders. By adding a training program, the nonprofit not only gains access to free filters (reducing costs and extending reach) but also improves sustainability through hygiene education, directly supporting the project’s mission to improve community health.

domande.domanda:
While monitoring the performance of a construction project, the project manager notices that the project is likely to drift away from the planned schedule.
Therefore, they implement ______________ in order to ensure that the project is fully aligned with the agreed-upon project baselines.

opzioni.A: Preventive actions
opzioni.B: Corrective actions
opzioni.C: Change request
opzioni.D: Defect repairs

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. When the project is likely to deviate from the planned scope, schedule, cost, or quality requirements, preventive actions must be taken. Such actions are based on a variance and trend analysis, and they’re proactive in nature (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 210-211).
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Corrective actions are reactive and are taken in order to bring the project performance back to the baseline when the project has already deviated from the scope, schedule, cost, or quality plan.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. A change request may include corrective actions, preventive actions, defect repairs, or updates that reflect modified or additional ideas or content (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 116-117).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Defect repair is implemented to adjust a nonconforming product or component.

domande.spiegazione: When the project is likely to deviate from the planned scope, schedule, cost, or quality requirements, preventive actions must be taken. Such actions are based on a variance and trend analysis, and they’re proactive in nature (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 210-211).

domande.domanda:
A project manager is working on a contract. Now that she has completed the contract and closed the project, the project manager is out of work.
What type of organizational structure does the project manager work in?

opzioni.A: Strong matrix
opzioni.B: Projectized
opzioni.C: Functional
opzioni.D: Weak matrix

domande.spiegazione: A Project-oriented organization, or a projectized organization, is one in which a considerable part of its processes and activities takes place in the form of projects. There is no defined hierarchy; resources are brought together specifically for the purpose of a project. When a project is complete, they either get transitioned to another project or released.

domande.domanda:
A project manager was assigned to organize a national event. The event has been planned and approved for execution. Three months separate the project manager from the big event, during which they will follow the iterative approach with 2-week-long iterations. Before starting any work, the project manager holds a meeting with the sponsor, project team, stakeholders, and key contractors.
What kind of meeting did the project manager hold?

opzioni.A: Iteration planning meeting
opzioni.B: Kick-off meeting
opzioni.C: Status meeting
opzioni.D: Scoping meeting

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The sprint planning meeting can’t be the correct answer for the given situation because the sponsor, stakeholders, and key contractors do not usually attend this meeting.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. A Project Kick-Off Meeting is considered the formal announcement of the project approval for execution. This meeting takes place at the beginning of the project, once the plan and the project itself get approved, but before executing or starting any work. The Project Kick-Off Meeting is usually attended by the sponsor, other managers, the project team, as well as contractors and vendors (Effective Project Management Traditional, Agile, Extreme, Hybrid by Robert K. Wysocki, Pages 272-273).
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The status meeting is used to track project progress when execution has already started (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 274).
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The scoping meeting is used to define the deliverables of the project, which, in this case, should have already taken place since the tournament has been planned and approved for execution as mentioned.

domande.spiegazione: A Project Kick-Off Meeting is considered the formal announcement of the project approval for execution. This meeting takes place at the beginning of the project, once the plan and the project itself get approved, but before executing or starting any work. The Project Kick-Off Meeting is usually attended by the sponsor, other managers, the project team, as well as contractors and vendors (Effective Project Management Traditional, Agile, Extreme, Hybrid by Robert K. Wysocki, Pages 272-273).

domande.domanda: The risk manager is collaborating with the project manager to perform a risk analysis. To determine the most likely project completion date based on known risks, they conduct a simulation using the _________________tool to go through thousands of possible scenarios.

opzioni.A: Monte Carlo analysis
opzioni.B: Decision-tree analysis
opzioni.C: Sensitivity analysis
opzioni.D: Influence diagrams

domande.spiegazione: The project manager and the risk manager are using the Monte Carlo analysis to assess the possible impact of individual project risks and other sources of uncertainty on project goals (PMBOK 8th edition, page 269). For example, if a particular risk arises, what impact will it have on the project schedule and cost? Monte Carlo provides a variety of potential outcomes and probabilities, allowing you to consider the likelihood of different scenarios.

domande.domanda:
In an industrial project, a project manager realized the need for a visual representation of the manufacturing process flow, which could also be used to determine when quality checks should be conducted.
Which diagramming technique would be most useful for the project manager’s needs?

opzioni.A: Flowchart
opzioni.B: Pareto chart
opzioni.C: Context diagram
opzioni.D: Scatter diagram

domande.spiegazione:
A flowchart (also referred to as process maps, progress flows, and progress flow diagrams) graphically displays the logical order of the project’s progress flow. Flowcharts can be used for process improvement as well as identifying where quality defects can occur or where to incorporate quality checks (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 170-171).
Options B & D: A Pareto chart is displayed as a histogram, illustrating the most serious causes of an error, while a scatter diagram is used to determine the correlation between two variables. Neither diagram shows the manufacturing process flow.
Option C: Context diagrams are used to visually demonstrate how a business process, other systems, and people, all interact. So, a context diagram can include a business process as one of its components, but it can’t give you an inside look at how the process flows.

domande.domanda:
Which statement is true about the following chart? [Dati ricostruiti dalla spiegazione: burndown di un'iterazione di 7 giorni; pianificati 14 story point, completati 11; linea effettiva sopra quella prevista]
⚠️ Nell'esportazione Udemy manca l'immagine (grafico/tabella) a cui fa riferimento la domanda.

opzioni.A: The figure represents a burnup chart of the remaining story points
opzioni.B: Throughout the iteration, the completed story points are always more than projected
opzioni.C: The team planned 14 story points for the iteration, which they completed
opzioni.D: 3 story points are unfinished at the end of the iteration

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. The figure represents a burndown chart and not a burnup chart.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. When the actual progress line of the chart is above the projected progress, it indicates that the team is finishing fewer story points than what they initially committed to.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. The team planned 14 story points, but they were only able to finish 11 story points.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. At the end of the seven-day iteration, 3 story points are left undone.

domande.spiegazione: At the end of the seven-day iteration, 3 story points are left undone.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a complex project with a very demanding sponsor. The sponsor wants to stay on top of every project progress update, as well as all planned subsequent work.
What’s the best way for the project manager to communicate with the sponsor?

opzioni.A: Send a comprehensive monthly report detailing all project progress aspects regarding scope, schedule, cost, risks, etc.
opzioni.B: Schedule a monthly face-to-face meeting to discuss the project status.
opzioni.C: Schedule a meeting once or twice a week and let the sponsor know that they can also attend daily standups.
opzioni.D: Schedule a fortnightly meeting and give the sponsor access to the project management software so they can check real-time updates concerning the project status.

domande.spiegazione:
Since the project is complex, frequent communication is required. Therefore, the best option is to schedule regular meetings once or twice a week, with the possibility of attending standup meetings to get daily updates.
Options A & B: Monthly meetings, even if they’re face-to-face, are not efficient for complex projects.
Option D: Giving access to the project management software is considered pull communication since the sponsor has to seek information themself. Pull communication might not be sufficient for high-power demanding stakeholders.

domande.domanda:
A project manager has just taken over an ongoing project for creating a newborns’ essentials brand. Items made of fabric are manufactured by external vendors.
To get to know all vendors involved in the project, the project manager should check out:

opzioni.A: RFQs
opzioni.B: Stakeholder register
opzioni.C: Vendors’ proposals
opzioni.D: Stakeholder engagement plan

domande.spiegazione: The stakeholder register document contains all relevant information concerning the project stakeholders, including their influence, interest, involvement, and potential impact on the project’s success (PMBOK 8th Edition, pages 141-142). External vendors are considered project stakeholders, and therefore, they should take part in the stakeholder register. The project manager should refer to this document whenever they need any information concerning both internal and external stakeholders.

domande.domanda:
An agile project manager noticed that several stakeholders have lost interest in the project; they rarely provide input, give feedback, or attend meetings.
What should the project manager do? (Select two)

opzioni.A: Send a reminder before each meeting
opzioni.B: Inform stakeholders that they can provide their feedback anonymously
opzioni.C: Value and show appreciation for everyone's ideas
opzioni.D: Demonstrate the working increments

domande.spiegazione:
Most probably, stakeholders are losing interest in the project because their input or feedback is being disregarded, or they are not seeing any tangible progress. The project manager has to engage stakeholders by taking their feedback into consideration to show them that their ideas are valued. The project manager should also demonstrate working increments as early in the project lifecycle as possible. This is considered one of the advantages of the agile approach that stakeholders expect and appreciate.
Options A & B: Sending reminders before each meeting or allowing for anonymous feedback does not yield more engagement, as both options don’t address the root cause of the problem.

domande.domanda:
A disaster relief project combines local volunteers, military personnel, and NGO workers with conflicting protocols. Tensions escalate when the military insists on hierarchical decision-making, while NGOs demand consensus.
What should the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Impose the military's chain of command to ensure rapid response.
opzioni.B: Remove the military from community-facing roles.
opzioni.C: Let subgroups operate independently to avoid conflict.
opzioni.D: Create a team agreement blending both approaches for different situations.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Imposing the military's chain-of-command can create resentment that hinders collaboration by silencing NGO voices and results in losing different perspectives that could improve relief efforts.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Removing the military from community-facing roles damages mutual trust among stakeholders, wastes valuable military skills in security/logistics, and could endanger volunteers by removing trained personnel from key roles.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Letting subgroups operate independently prevents synergistic effects from their interactions, creates silos contrary to unity in shared objectives, allows cultural misunderstandings to fester without structured resolution, and fails to build an empowered culture that fosters proactive collaboration.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Correct. Creating a blended team agreement recognizes different perspectives, establishes clear norms, prevents conflicts by providing full clarity on individual roles, demonstrating respect for diverse skills, knowledge, and experience, and defines when hierarchical vs. consensus approaches apply, enabling collaboration and addressing territorial complexities.

domande.spiegazione: Creating a blended team agreement recognizes different perspectives, establishes clear norms, prevents conflicts by providing full clarity on individual roles, demonstrating respect for diverse skills, knowledge, and experience, and defines when hierarchical vs. consensus approaches apply, enabling collaboration and addressing territorial complexities.

domande.domanda:
A project manager floated a Request for Proposal (RFP) to acquire an inventory management system. To clarify some points, the project manager held a bidder conference with the prospective sellers.
What should the project manager do during the bidder conference? (Select two)

opzioni.A: Award the contract
opzioni.B: Clarify any doubts
opzioni.C: Share the bid document with participants
opzioni.D: Shortlist prospective sellers
opzioni.E: Explain the bid terms and conditions

domande.spiegazione:
Bidder conference, aka contractor conference or vendor conference, is arranged to ensure that sellers have a common understanding of the project procurement requirements (PMBOK 8th edition, page 265). During the conference, the project manager and the stakeholders will discuss their procurement needs and answer any questions the sellers might have.
Option A & D: In a bidder conference, the project manager does not shortlist prospective sellers or award the contract.
Option C: The bid document has to be shared with participants before the bidder conference.

domande.domanda: While traditional project management follows predefined phases and sticks to the predetermined scope, Agile project management approaches:

opzioni.A: Encapsulate analysis, design, implementation, and test within an iteration.
opzioni.B: Involve documenting, estimating, and sequencing each planned activity in detail.
opzioni.C: Use Gantt charts along with well-defined activities, responsibilities, and time frames.
opzioni.D: Map the iteration backlog into a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).

domande.spiegazione:
The iterative method is the heart of the Agile development process. Each iteration generates a piece of the product until the final product is fully completed and delivered (PMBOK 8th Edition, page 63).
A typical iteration process flow involves:
Analysis: to define the iteration requirements based on the product backlog, sprint backlog, and feedback from customers and stakeholders.
Development: includes design and implementation based on the defined requirements.
Testing: involves Quality Assurance testing.
Delivery: integrating the working iteration into production,
Feedback: receiving customer and stakeholder feedback to define the requirements of the next iteration.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading an agricultural project involving three stakeholders with high authority. By analyzing each of these stakeholders, the project manager identifies Stakeholder A as the one who has the most interest in the project.
What strategy should the project manager use for managing Stakeholder A?

opzioni.A: Manage closely
opzioni.B: Keep satisfied
opzioni.C: Keep informed
opzioni.D: Monitor

domande.spiegazione: According to the power/interest grid, stakeholders with high power and high interest should be managed closely.

domande.domanda:
A project manager is leading a manufacturing project that relies on critical components sourced from an external vendor. During execution, the initially selected vendor experiences unexpected production delays due to equipment failure and cannot deliver the parts by the required date. After evaluating alternatives, the project manager identifies another vendor who can supply the parts, but at a higher cost. The change control board reviews the request, approves the change, and authorizes the purchase.
What did the project manager do?

opzioni.A: Implemented a workaround.
opzioni.B: Applied risk mitigation strategies.
opzioni.C: Initiated a risk transfer process.
opzioni.D: Accepted the risk and proceeded with an alternative.

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Correct. In this scenario, the project manager is responding to a realized risk (vendor delay) by using a workaround; a temporary solution implemented without prior planning to address an issue that has already occurred. The workaround involves sourcing parts from an alternate vendor after approval through the change control process.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Incorrect. Risk mitigation refers to actions taken before a risk occurs to reduce its probability or impact. Since the delay has already happened, mitigation is not the appropriate response. Mitigation would have been applied earlier, such as by selecting multiple vendors or building buffer time into the schedule.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. Risk transfer involves shifting the financial or operational burden of a risk to a third party (e.g., through insurance or contracts). While the new vendor bears the cost of production, this does not constitute risk transfer in the formal sense because the project team still manages the procurement and integration of the parts. Transfer requires contractual mechanisms like indemnity clauses, which are not described here.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. Risk acceptance means acknowledging a risk and choosing not to take action. In this case, accepting the delay would jeopardize project timelines and deliverables. The project manager took proactive steps to resolve the issue, so acceptance is not applicable.

domande.spiegazione: In this scenario, the project manager is responding to a realized risk (vendor delay) by using a workaround; a temporary solution implemented without prior planning to address an issue that has already occurred. The workaround involves sourcing parts from an alternate vendor after approval through the change control process.

domande.domanda:
Three manufacturing lines are producing 5 mm diameter cylindrical steel bars. In order to perform a quality inspection, the project manager takes 10 random bars from each line. The following are the inspection results in mm measurements.
The results of Line 1 can be described as: [Dati ricostruiti dalla spiegazione: le 10 barre della Linea 1 misurano circa 4.45 mm (±0.05 mm); target 5.00 mm]
⚠️ Nell'esportazione Udemy manca l'immagine (grafico/tabella) a cui fa riferimento la domanda.

opzioni.A: Accurate
opzioni.B: Precise
opzioni.C: Both accurate and precise
opzioni.D: Neither accurate nor precise

spiegazioni_opzioni.A: Incorrect. Accuracy refers to how close the measurements are to the specified target of 5.00 mm. Since the bars produced by Line 1 are consistently around 4.45 mm, they are approximately 0.55 mm below the required diameter. Therefore, the measurements are not accurate, even though they are very consistent.
spiegazioni_opzioni.B: Correct. The results are precise because all measurements are close to 4.45mm (+ or - 0.05mm). Precision entails delivering end-products with similar dimensions, which may or may not be close to the required dimensions. Precise measurements are not necessarily close to the target value; they’re just close to one another.
spiegazioni_opzioni.C: Incorrect. For the measurements to be both accurate and precise, they would need to be clustered closely together and centered around the target diameter of 5.00 mm. While the Line 1 measurements are tightly grouped, they are all significantly below the target value. As a result, the manufacturing line demonstrates precision but not accuracy.
spiegazioni_opzioni.D: Incorrect. The measurements clearly demonstrate precision. The diameters vary by only about ±0.05 mm, showing excellent consistency. Although the measurements are not accurate, they are far from being random or widely scattered, so they cannot be described as neither accurate nor precise.

domande.spiegazione: The results are precise because all measurements are close to 4.45mm (+ or - 0.05mm). Precision entails delivering end-products with similar dimensions, which may or may not be close to the required dimensions. Precise measurements are not necessarily close to the target value; they’re just close to one another.
